Jack Slash POV

.

Tossing the pink lunchbox to the side, one of Bonesaw's little spider borgs collects and scurries off to, somewhere. Probably to stash it for Bonesaw to use the aluminum later.

"Cherish." I look to the curious, freckle faced girl. "Be a dear and lend us your laptop."

"Yeah sure." She rolls her eyes and gets up, not bothering with a snarky remark as she gets her metal framed computer from her bag. Bringing it over and setting it in front of me as I sit back down at the table. "Here, just don't break it."

Bonesaw and Mannequin get up and stand behind me as I open it and type in the password. Giving Cherish a smile as I take in her worry over me knowing her password.

"Alright then, time to see what little Kitsu sent us." I say as I plug the flash drive into the laptop. Causing a new icon to boot up, labeled Shortcut 1. Opening it, I see the only thing in it is a URL link. Clicking it opens a webpage with the error sign. And I realize we're not connected to a network.

"Do we have Wi-Fi here?" I ask the three behind me.

Bonesaw shrugs and Mannequin gives a thumbs down.

"Well, that's inconvenient." I say as I unplug the flash drive. But it doesn't budge. At all, like it's magnetically attached. "Huh, well that's not concerning in the least."

"Be careful!" Cherish says. "Do you know how hard it is to get a decent laptop and not have it bugged?"

Rolling my eyes at her dramatics, I nonetheless stop. It would be a bigger inconvenience to have our only access to the internet disabled.

"Mannequin, do you think you could look at it?" I ask the faceless man.

I look back and see him nod. Getting up out of the chair, I let him have a crack at it. For all we know it's just stuck. Or it's booby trapped. But I can't think of anyway Kitsu would be able to rig an electronic. She's not a tinker or anything. Unless there's something I missed-

Click!

"Oh, did you get it out?" I ask, before noticing Mannequin twitching.

I turn as I hear the door slam shut. And notice Cherish had taken off. Leaving me, Bonesaw and the twitching Mannequin.

"Hmm." I hum as I realize the stage currently being set.

"Jack, what's going on?" Bonesaw asks with a tilt of her head.

"It seems… little Kitsu is cheating." I say as I turn to Mannequin and watch as he slumps. His limps falling limp as his finger is connected to the auxiliary input of the laptop. A loading screen now showing up on the screen.

And we see Little Kitsu show up on the screen. Smiling with eyes red. Two stripes of blonde fur on her cheeks. It looks as though she's in a rusted and abandoned building. Like us.

"If you're seeing this, you're alive and I get to have fun!" She smiles gleefully. "If you had access to wifi then the flash drive would've blown up with the force of a one pound block of TNT. Minecraft style! But, since you opened it without wifi, you no doubt tried to remove it, failed, and had Mannequin do it. Not saying what happened because you can suck a cactus for all I care!"

"Rude!" Bonesaw stomps her foot.

"So, here is how this is going to go. See, I think it's about time you got your turn to play a game." Kitsu give a smile as the camera turns to the side and reveals a caged Mimi, and the head of Crawler sticking out of the ground outside. Everything around is made to look like a jungle. Likely her illusions keeping her location hidden. "You have two of mine, I have two of yours."

'So, she intends to bargain them back.' I sigh tiredly. 'How, uninspired.'

"So, here's the game." Kitsu grins. "Ever play the new Halo game? Well, you get to be Noble Six. Welcome to the final mission."

"What?" I ask out loud.

"If you fail, Mimi dies." She smiles brightly. "And Bonesaw, your task is to return Amy and my Dad to my house. Unharmed, unchanged and in as good a condition as you took them. Otherwise, Siberian and Crawler die."

The image cuts out and the laptop screen goes black.

"What did she mean by Halo?" Bonesaw asks. "And how does she have Sibby? I thought Cherish said, wait, did Cherish lie!? Hang on, she said she has two! Is she lying, are they both lying?"

'At this point, it's likely.' I think to myself as I tap my chin. Before turning to Mannequin. "Well, there's little we can do about it now. Other than-"

I'm cut off as the roof caves in. A scaly, orange man with large bat wings crashing through the ceiling. And heading straight for me.

"Woah now!" I sidestep and dodge his charge. "So that's how it is?"

I grin as I take one of my knives out and throw a slash out. But the cut never makes contact as the man turns around and twirls midair, deftly dodging the invisible cut. And I notice him wearing a red and gold helmet visor.

"Well, that's neat." I comment as he touches down on the ground. "New style Firebreather?"

He doesn't answer as I watch his chest start to glow. And I take the chance to send out a slash as he stills. Landing a shallow cut on his chest before I have to jump away from a fire ball.

Only to get hit as he rapid fires a stream of fireballs. That's new.

"Jack!" I hear Bonesaw call out through the whoosh of flames consuming my senses. Grateful for Bonesaw's enhancements keeping me alive.

Angling a hard slash as another ball hits me. I pant as the stream ends. The orange Case 53 holding his face as the helmet lays on the floor, cut into two pieces on either side of him. Blood dripping down his face.

"Bonesaw dear." I say through pant of breath. "I believe our guest here needs a lesson in manners."

"On it!" She salutes and pulls out a small remote.

"Don't even-" Firebreather calls out, glaring as he holds his wounded face. But she presses the button anyway. Opening one of the storage crates.

"Go, Whirlwind!" She cheerfully shouts as the chimeric parahuman steps out of the crate.

Two toned skin of Caucasian mix. One eye blue and one green. Half his hair blonde and half brown. Wires coming out of his neck and going into his shoulders like corded muscles.

"That is sick." Firebreather grimaces as his one good eye looks up Bonesaw's latest work of art. A mix of Charybdis and Sky High.

With said work of art raising a hand and shooting a pulse of swirling air out with a pwoom.

The blast connects and sends him out of the warehouse. Crashing through the wall with a screech as it tears and rends the metal.

"Well, I have to say this-" I'm cut off as by the sound of something, off. Like a light, whispy bamf.

"Guten tag!" I hear behind me before a hand grabs my shoulder, and I'm suddenly several stories above the ground.

I turn around as I start to fall and see a grinning blue demon as they let go and salute.

I try to throw a slash out, but they disappear in a wisp of black smoke. My cut merely causing the smoke to waft away. Leaving me to fall to the ground below.

Looking around, I think fast as I fall. And spot a crane with an old, corded hook. Throwing out another slash, I cut the cord. Causing it to swing my way.

I reach out to grab it. Only to watch in shock as the crane itself starts moving. The base of the crane caving in on itself.

'How the hell?' I think as the old equipment falls with me.

I grit my teeth as I prepare for impact. Knowing I'll survive the landing but not looking forward to the impact. Or the crane that might land on me.

I don't have to worry about that, however. As I'm caught by a blast of air that slows my descent, if a tad roughly.

Spin and land on the concrete dockyard. Scraping my back and arms against the pavement something fierce as I roll. Stopping just as the crane lands with a loud crash in front of me. My wounds are all superficial, scrapes barely enough to bleed. But hell if it doesn't hurt.

"Whoo." I exclaim as I get up and dust off my pants. My shirt now being a mess of tattered cloth. Burned and shredded.

Looking around, I see a score of cargo containers and a few buildings. Making a veritable maze in this dockyard. One I can use to my advantage as I run and duck behind a cargo container while Whirlwind fights off Firebreather.

"Knock knock!" I hear a raspy voice say quickly before a blue streak passes by. And I feel a sharp pain in my jaw as I stare at the ground. "Down low!"

I feel the pain in my chin as I stare at the sky, a thumping pain in my skull as I land on my back.

"Too slow!" I see a brief image of... a blue lizard? Before a beeping is heard and it disappears.

Standing up, I shake my head clear. Once again grateful for the enhancements Bonesaw added to me. Otherwise, that headache might have lasted a bit longer.

'Need to hide.' I think to myself as I duck behind another shipping container.

Taking a breath. I listen to the sounds of battle as Whirlwind takes on Firebreather. Relying on my sense of sound to keep me up to date on the fight.

'No Mannequin. No Siberian. No Crawler, Burnscar or Cherish.' I think to myself as I look to the sky and try to think.

Only for my eyes to widen as they meet the yellowed eyed gaze of the blue skinned demon dropping down with a knife.

Spinning around I brandish my knife from my belt to slash his chest. One he deftly dodges with a limbo, his tail shooting up and grabbing my wrist. Pulling down as he shanks my side. The internal carbon mesh under my skin doing its job as the blade is stopped from hitting anything important past the skin.

"Scheisse." He spits out.

I twist my wrist, angling the knife down to nick his tail. Forcing him to let go with a hiss of pain. And then poof out of existence.

'Need a better hiding spot.' I think as I move.

Snapping my gaze back to the device. I feel a grin stretch across my face as I cycle through the numbers and pick a speedy character. Knowing I can't stick around the guy too long.

Allegedly.

"Come on, there!" I say as I hit the icon. Feeling an initial sting as I slam the device down before the safety kicks in. Shutting off my pain receptors as I painlessly grow a thin membrane under my arms and feel my spin distend. My skin thickening and my neck growing an extra layer of muscle.

Unfurling myself just in time to skid across the ground. My shirt torn to shreds and leaving me in my stretchy cargo pants.

I sit up and catch my breath. Looking down at my bloodstained body. And I notice the sticky wetness on my back.

"It wasn't a person." I say to myself as I clench my eyes shut and push the thoughts out of my head. "It was just a zombie. Like playing a video game. Like Resident Evil."

'You're fine. It's fine.' I think to myself as I feel a spicy burn in the back of my throat. Like a bad case of heartburn. 'No one got hurt. You saved Fire. You're a hero.'

'A hero on a timer.' A darker part of me whispers.

.

.

Firebreather POV

.

'Damn.' I think as I touch down on the ground, staring at the small crater in the concrete. And at the mangled pancake that was Whirlwind. 'No wonder Ben has an ego.'

Took him all of thirty seconds to jump in and take out the guy giving me trouble for the past three minutes.

"Someone, check in on Ben." I say as I turn to the warehouse and touch down.

"You broke him!" The little blonde girl peeking out of the warehouse whines. Stomping her foot angrily. "I liked that one! Do you know how hard it is to find two people with such complementary powers!? You didn't even get to see how he flies." She moans sadly at the end.

I know her appearance should be off putting. Make me feel something about her. Like, it's just a little girl! But, living around and training with Kitsu has left us all… desensitized.

"There are three left in the warehouse. I can't make out if either are Mark and Amy, or others." Jenny says. "For all I know, all three are more freaky zombie people."

"Then I say we take her now." I say as I walk towards the girl. Keeping my fire ready. Both to use, and to keep my body temp up and kill any diseases or parasites she might toss at me.

This is why me and Jenny are the ones focusing on Bonesaw and finding the hostages. Jenny isn't organic. And I can raise my body temp to absurd degrees.

"What, hey." The little girl says, her eyes going wide as she realizes who my target is. She starts back pedaling further into the warehouse. "Stay back! Stranger danger! Mister Jack! Help me!" She screams.

"I'm on my way to assist!" Jenny says. "Just in case she has something."

"She has everything." Pinky says. "Her whole deal is medicine made evil."

"Guys!" Gully calls out. "Jack is beelining south towards Firebreather."

I pivot on my feet and gather the heat in my throat as I watch Jack round the side of a shipping container. Not wasting time thinking, I let loose a torrent of flame.

"Argh!" I wince and step back as my vision is lost. Jack having somehow aimed right at my other eye with his slashes. Cutting through my flames.

"Fuck!" I curse as I cover my face. Extending my wings and taking flight immediately.

"Fire! Are you okay?" Pinky asks.

"Firebreather, what happened?" Gully asks.

"I'm blind! He managed to get both of my eyes when I tried to get him!" I hiss as the air make my wounds sting.

"I got you!" I hear the accented voice of Nightcrawler say over the comms then right next to me as I feel a hand on my shoulder. "You can stop flying."

I do as he says and feel my feet touch the pavement.

"Hey Fire." I hear Pinky say tiredly. "How's everything going?"

I sit down on the ground and let out a groan.

"At least no one's dead!" I hear Kitsu say cheerfully. "Now sit up, gotta get you new peepers or Crystal might try to shave my tail."

.

.

Jenny POV

.

I crash down between Jack Slash and Bonesaw. Raising my hands up to the two serial killers, I power my hand canons and allow them to glow with charge as I take in the two.

Bonesaw looks as creepy as always. Blood covered little girl that she is. Jack looks like a mix of Freddy Krueger and Johnny Depp. His shirt gone, his right arm and shoulder freshly burned, and pock marks of sizzling and boiling skin from Pinky's acid.

"Alright creepazoids." I say as I look between the two and try to think of something.

We need to take Bonesaw alive and kill Jack. But we can't let Bonesaw know we killed Jack. Otherwise, she might go all plague doctor and kill Mr. Dallon and Amy. Among a potential score of people.

That's why we were keeping them separate.

"Well, it seems you have us at a disadvantage." Jack smiles serenely, half his face burned with a hole in his cheek. "You no doubt know us, but might I get your name?"

'Someone, tell me what to do!' I think frantically. 'What's the call? Do I take Bonesaw and leave Amy and Mr. Dallon at the mercy of Jack? Or do I take out Jack and possibly kill off Amy and Mr. Dallon?'

And after we went through the effort of separating them!

"You got this!" I hear as I keep my eyes on Jack.

I look back over to Bonesaw just in time to see the wisps of black smoke as Nightcrawler whisks her away.

I feel a pressure on my neck as I turn to look back at Jack. And see him with a knife in his hand.

"I must say." He says as he loses his smile. "This is getting to be rather, frustrating."

"That's my line." I say as I aim both my hands at him and let the energy beams fly out.

Jack dodges to the side. Avoiding both lasers and throwing another cut out. One I feel press against my eyes. But doesn't do anything.

"Really?" I roll my eyes and aim, charge, and shoot. "Bit of a one trick pony!"

"What can I say?" He says as he kicks a metal beam in the way of my laser. "If it works, it works."

"Yeah well, it's not." I scoff and shoot him again, gritting my teeth as he somehow dodges and ducks back into the maze of shipping containers. "Rrr! Get back here!"

I blast after him, taking flight as I follow him. And immediately lose him as I take the corner he took.

"What?" I ask as I scan my eyes over the area.

"Above you!" Gully yells into the comms.

I blast forward and turn around. Spotting Jack on top of the container he had disappeared behind. And watch as he jumps down on the other side.

"Oh no you don't!" I say as I go after him.

"Jenny, you've been around him too much." Gully says. "You need to head back, make sure he can't master you!"

"I'm fine." I say as I run and round the corner, only to find he disappeared again.

"No, you're not!" Gully says. "Jenny you're being reckless. And not even in the way you normally are. He should be no match for you and yet you're struggling just to keep up with him. Fall back!"

"I'm just getting frustrated is all!" I say into the comms. "Just lay off me and let me do this!"

"Behind you!"

I feel sharp pain course through me as my vision blacks out. My limps no long responding as I try to move.

"Huh, Taser beats robot." I hear behind me. "Good to know."

'How!?' I think as I can't feel, anything! 'No, no this is not how I end up on the news!'

My vision slowly returns as I look into the brown eyes of the psychotic serial killer. His grimy hand holding my chin as he squats over me. Taser and knife in his other hand.

"Now then, let's see what we can do." He says as he sticks the blade under my eye and grins maniacally. "That's it! Now let's see what your worth to your friends."

My vision shakes as the ground rumbles. And Jack looks up, clicking his tongue as looks out at something.

"You're like roaches." He says as he lets go of the knife, and I see nothing as he presses the Taser to my head.

.

.

Gully POV

.

"Get away from her!" I shout as I stab my shovel into the ground and open a crack the dock under him. Making him fall into the hole as water fills the crack. The Taser dropping next to Jenny.

Abandoning my shovel, I run over and grab Jenny along with the Taser. Carefully dislodging the knife wedged under her left eye before pocketing that as well.

Evidence or tool, take what you can get.

"Jenny, Jenny!" I try to shake her awake. Cursing as she doesn't respond.

I heft her up, struggling to hold her entire six hundred pound frame over my shoulders as I start jogging away.

"Agh!" I cry out in pain as I feel my ankles slashed, my legs giving out and forcing me to fall forward. Jenny rolling over me and fumbling to the ground before me with a thick clang.

Looking back, I grit my teeth as I see the soaked, half burned man crawl out of the crack. One hand on the ground holding him up, the other with a knife extended. His black, slicked back hair now cascading over his face. Panting heavily with a manic grin on his face.

"You, you just keep coming." He huffs out in a shaky voice. "Hah, heh ha! To think this-"

I don't let him finish as I slam a fist to the ground and close the fissure with him inside. And grit my teeth in frustration as he pulls himself up fast enough to avoid being crushed.

"To think, Kitsu went so far out of her way." He pants as he starts stalking forward, knife in hand, open mouthed grin as he brandishes his butcher knife. "To set this all up... and couldn't even bother to show up herself. Guess I was wrong about her."

He chuckles as he runs a hand up his face and slicks his hair back.

"No matter." He sighs, his face resting to a calmer smile.

'I need to get out of here!' I think to myself as I glance down and notice the profuse amount of blood I'm losing.

"If she's not serious enough to show up, I have no reason to keep any hostages." Jack finishes.

He flicks his wrist, and I wince as I feel a deep gash form on my shoulder. Panicking slightly as I quickly lose all feeling in my arm.

"First though." Jack says as he walks beside me and looks down at me with a calm, almost friendly smile. "You need to tell me where you took little Bonesaw."

"I will." I say through labored breath as I feel my consciousness start to fade, my heart beating faster and faster in my chest as I realize this is where I die. But I feel something through the ground. Someone is coming!

'I just, just need to hold out!' I think as I feel the individual running our way.

"Just, promise me one thing… first." I tell the looming edgelord.

"If it'll put you at ease." He says as he presses the blade to my neck, giving me a sympathetic smile. "I'll make it quick. That's a lot more than some get."

"Good." I grin. "You can find her next to your grave. Now hurry up and rot in hell."

I pull the Taser from pocket and shove it into his leg. It won't kill him, but hell if he gets the last laugh.

"Aaaagh!" He tenses up, dropping the cleaver and falling back.

I crawl back and sit myself up next to Jenny, wincing when I try to move my legs. I realize I'm standing anytime soon.

"Today… just isn't my day." My chest goes cold at Jack's words.

I look up to see the man shakily getting to his feet. And balk at just all he's been put through and survived.

Jack doesn't say anything else as he walks towards me.

"We're done here." He says as he shakily bends down and grabs his cleaver. Stands up and swings his arm out.

I close my eyes and await the end. And then, three things happen at once.

The first, is the person I felt running finally makes it over. And I hear their footsteps. The second, is a sudden rumbling in the ground. The third, is Jack crying out in pain.

Opening my eyes, I feel a wave of relief and shock wash over me before I pass out. The last thing I see, is a glowing spear lodged inside Jack's shoulder. The second, is a white capsule erupting out of the ground in front of me, before it recedes into the form of a thin man with frizzy brown hair.

"Jack, long time no see."

-Boat Graveyard, Sunday, October 3rd, 5:50pm-

John "The Marquis" Lavere POV

.

"Jack, long time no see." I say as the bones I used to tunnel through the concrete recede back into me. I look him up and down, taking in his haggard form. Shirtless, half burned, wet. And there are pock marks in his skin that trigger a mild sense of trypophobia in me. "You've certainly seen better days."

He stands up straight, angling an appraising glare at me as he tilts his head.

"I'm sorry, do I know you?" He asks before chuckling. "I seem to be saying that a lot lately."

I give an unimpressed huff. Not particularly buying into his false bravado.

"Carol, be a dear and see to the girl's injuries." I say as I undo my cufflinks and fold up my sleeves.

"Piss, the fuck off." She glowers as she loudly marches up next to me.

"Mrs. Dallon!" Jack smiles as the spear in his left shoulder dissipates, leaving a cauterized hole. "A pleasure to see you." He gives a sarcastic bow. "Unfortunately I can't exactly greet you-"

I step to the side as I can practically feel her anger. And none too soon as she winds up a spear and tosses it.

Jack steps to the side, dodging the spear with a smile as he sends out a slash.

Throwing my arm up, I form a shield of bone around my forearm to cover Carol in an instant. The slash splintering parts of the surface off. But not going through.

I pull my arm back and quickly grab the splinters as they fall. Then swing my arm back out, throwing them like caltrops at the serial killer. Watching as they pop at his feet, sending small shards into his legs.

"You've gotten faster with your weapons." I comment to my temporary teammate. "I remember when it would take you at least a few seconds."

We may have our hang-ups. But I'm still a gentleman, and she still protected my daughter for the last decade. When she could've easily just abandoned her after my trial.

And I would've been none the wiser. So, I owe her respect at least.

"And your voice still pisses me off." She growls as she marches past me. Two axes instantly forming in her hands as Jack shakily stumbles. Throwing out a slash that Carol forms a light shield to defend against before reforming the axes and charging in.

"You can't win them all." I sigh to myself before turning around to the large Hispanic woman currently bleeding out from the ankles.

I crouch down, keeping my ear to the fight as I check her ankles. Seeing the severed arteries, I extend the bones from my fingers to form a pair of rough clamps as I dig in and clamp the arteries shut.

She might lose her feet from this if she doesn't get help immediately. But she has a better chance of coming out of this alive, as opposed to bleeding out on the pavement.

"There you go." I say as I stand and turn to the fight, confident I bought her a few extra minutes at least.

Carol is currently in a melee, hacking and slashing at the man as he slashes wildly. Lashing out like a cornered animal.

Sighing, I use the back of my hand to push some hair out of my face. Then raise my other hand into finger pistols. I shoot hollow point finger tip bones at the man. Aiming for non vital, but debilitating spots as he dodges. His shoulder, right near the hole. While simultaneously sending bone spikes down through my feet and tunneling through the concrete dock.

"Agh!" He gives a voice cracking gasp as the hollow points shatter in his skin. Wincing and backing against a shipping container as Carol goes for the kill. Aiming to behead him with her right axe, he drops down and stabs her thigh.

"Rrrh!" She grits her teeth, but doesn't let it stop her as she hacks down with her left.

Jack tries to dodge, but I send the bone spears up out of the ground. Stabbing through his feet and nailing him in place. Giving Carol the opportunity to cut Jack's hand off. Cauterizing the wound with the sheer heat of her photon weapons. Leaving the knife in her thigh as his hand falls limp to the ground.

"Ahhh! Ffffuck!" Jack curses as he presses his stump to his chest. Falling back pathetically against the shipping container while I will the bones to harden and curl. Keeping him firmly trapped.

"Well now. If that wasn't underwhelming." I say as I walk over, coming up behind my old foe as she grabs the knife in her thigh. "I wouldn't-"

"Rrr!" Carol ignores me as she yanks the knife from her leg, and drops down. Kneeling before Jack and stabbing him in the thigh.

'Well, I guess it's fine.' I shrug as I let the bones connected to my feet detach. Breaking off as I start walking.

"Where are they?" Carol asks in an angered huff as she grabs Jack's hair and forces him to look her in the eye. "Tell me!"

She bashes his head against the shipping container.

"What, what if I said they were dead?" He grins an ugly, bloody smile.

I put a hand on Carol's shoulder as she raises her hand and forms a dagger. Stopping her before she can kill him as she looks back to me with a glare.

I don't bother placating her with words. Instead giving her a stern look and soft shake of my head.

She huffs, and lets the dagger fade from existence as she gets up. Shakily getting to her feet on an injured leg. She steps back, allowing me to take her place kneeling before Jack.

"To answer your question." I say slowly as the half dead man looks up to meet my eyes. "I'd call your bluff."

He grins at my words, and I smile back. Maintaining my smile as I grab the handle of the knife in his leg.

"You're a shit liar." I say with a small, patronizing nod. "Now, answer me."

"And end this so-ah!" He gives a small hiss as I slowly pull the knife out.

"You're lucky you missed the femoral artery." I say a bit louder for Carol to hear me clearly as the wind picks up around us. "It'd be rather hard to get info from an unconscious man."

"I know where I stabbed him." She defends. "Remember, I've been an active hero for the last ten years."

"Just saying, accidents can happen." I say.

"Are you going to get answers out of him or criticize my stabbing techniques." She snaps.

"I can do both." I defend as I put the knife against his chest and use the tip to make a small, slow cut down to his belly button. "Now if only we had some bleach."

"Ooh, now that's an ideaaaaahhh!" He starts screaming as I slide the knife in a semi circle, and dig it under before raking it down. Removing a patch of skin.

"That's disgusting." Carol says in a perturbed tone of voice. Sounding as though she may throw up at any moment.

"Agreed. I used to have a guy for this but." I shrug. "I doubt he's around anymore. Or even up at this hour if he is." I then go back to Jack, tapping the knife against his chin. "Now, that was for lying the first time. Lie again, give me an answer I don't like, and I do it again. Simple as that. So, wanna try again?"

"You, I remember now." He grins weakly. "You're-aaaaahhahahaaa!"

I carve another half circle below his sternum, and scrape it out.

"You're a shit liar Jack." I give a small laugh. "Didn't I tell you this already? You recognized me the moment you saw me. Now, stop stalling. No one's coming to help you, no one is going to save you." I give him a sad smile. "Get it through your head already, you're done. You lose, game over."

I stand up and leer over him. Before letting my mask fall, giving the shitstain below me my nastiest glare as I raise a foot, extend a sharpened bone through my heel, and stomp his crotch.

"Aaaaagghhh!" He cries out, and then starts actually crying.

"If you kill him, I'll kill you." Carol growls.

'You can certainly try.' I think to myself as I keep my focus on the man beneath me.

"This is only going to get worse." I say, putting the mask back on. "Don't make me start breaking my own rules Jack. Neither of us wants to do that."

"You, you." He huffs out through pained, haggard breaths. "You wouldn't! You're not that-"

I make the bone at my heel move inside Jack. Growing bone spikes and turning into a veritable blender on his crotch.

"AAAAAHHHHH!" He lets out a blood curdling scream as I make good on my word. And break my rule of never engaging in any sexual violence as I geld the man.

"That's one rule broken." I tell the crying man before leaning over and grabbing his jaw. Staring him dead in the eye as clouds gather above. "Want me to break another?"

.

Kitsu POV

.

"Are you sure you-" Fire starts again.

"Yes!" I groan. "You can open your eyes you big baby."

"Be nice!" Pinky chastises me from atop her crate. "He just had his eyes slashed out. You're fine Fire."

"They were still in his head." I grumble and look away. "So, not out. Just slashed."

"What's the difference?" Pinky whines, exasperated with me for some reason.

Before I can educate the poor, rejected mascot of Pepto-Bismol. I'm interrupted by another bamf.

"Okay Night, whatchu got-" I stop as I turn to the blue demon man, currently holding a flailing Bonesaw in his arms. One hand over her mouth, the other held tight around her midsection as she kicks and thrashes.

But the big thing, is the green veins angrily spreading across his body.

"Hey, kleine fuchsin." He gives a weak grin. "She, jabbed me with, something krank."

"Night!" Pinky shouts as she jumps off of the crate she was perched on.

"Nein!" Nightcrawler whips his tail out to keep Pinky at a distance. "Stay back! I, might be contagious."

"Yeah well, we'll deal with that later." I say as I step in and place a hand on Night's shoulder. And look into his body. And find a series of bacteria inside him, eating fat and producing sulfur of all things!

Sending a wave of microbe death throughout his body, killing any and all things I can find that has any amount of sulfur on it. I let go of him and turn to Firebreather.

"You'll be fine now." I say, addressing Nightcrawler, before turning my attention to Fire. "Fire, you're good to go back. I'll keep Bonesaw here."

"Alright, I guess." He shrugs and finally opens his eyes as he stands up off of the cot. His eyes opening wide as he regards Nightcrawler. "Um, are you good to do this man?"

"I'm, fine." He says in a woozy way.

"He's not." I say as I take Bonesaw from him.

"Let go of me!" She screams and kicks. "As your big sister I demand you let me go! Little sisters listen to big sisters! Those are the rules!"

"I will stab you." I say as I place her on the bed where Fire was just sitting. And bend the metal frame to hold the girl who is, technically younger, but still taller than me.

"You will not!" She says as she squirms and grabs a spray bottle from inside her dress.

"Alright." I shrug and grab her right arm, and crush her wrist. "Guess I won't."

"Owie!" She winces and pouts at me. "Do you know how long it takes to heal hands? Do you know how long it'll take me to heal my own hand? Like, an hour!... Wait, I'm right handed, two hours!"

Ignoring her, I turn to the blue-green demon, and red-orange demon.

"Night, go home." I make a shooing motion. "Fire, get going."

"I thought you said, I was fine." Nightcrawler says as Firebreather shrugs and heads for the door.

"No, I said you will be fine." I, shoo him again. "Now shoo, go. Sleep, become unconscious mister German."

Nightcrawler's slumps his shoulders. Giving a tired sigh with a shake of his head, before chuckling.

"Never change Kitsu." He smiles and bamfs away.

I turn to Bonesaw, and place a hand on her head. Looking into her biology, I get to work disarming everything. The seventeen diseases, twenty three viruses, five parasites. Secondary peripheral nervous system. The nerve cluster in the back of her spine attached to a secondary cartilage casing.

There's a lot.

"You're very rude." Pinky says. "You know that?"

"I know right?" Bonesaw agrees.

"Don't… don't agree with me." Pinky groans.

'This is going to be a while.' I feel my eye twitch.

"Why not?" Bonesaw asks. "I'm just saying that certain little girls need to learn some manners!"

I move my hand and stare into her heterochromatic eyes. Now knowing that one of them isn't hers in origin.

"What?" She asks, and I form an illusionary dagger. And push it into her liver.

"Stab." I say plainly.

…

"You stabbed me!" She shouts in disbelief after a few moments.

-Boat Graveyard, Sunday, October 3rd, 6:00pm-

Carol "Brandish" Dallon POV

.

I hold myself back from commenting as The Marquis renders Jack's chest fleshless. Down to a weird gray mesh under his skin that the knife can't go through. Otherwise there'd be a few nerve pockets The Marquis insists would get him to talk.

Everything in me is telling, no screaming, at me to stop this. That this is wrong. That if it ever got out that I was complicit in a torture, regardless of who it was, my life would be over. Ended in a blaze of slander.

"Okay! Okay, okay." The broken man cries.

"Wow, not even ten minutes." The Marquis comments as he stands up, and lazily holds the bone knife in one hand. The regular knife having broken when he tried to stab into Jack's gut. "Now talk, before I call in some old favors."

This… is the real Marquis. Sure he has a code of ethics he sticks to. He's charismatic and well spoken, relatable even. But under it all, he's a cruel and hedonistic warlord. He has his code not out of any sense of morality, but out of a sense of ego. His code keeps him from debasing himself.

A true psychopath. Intelligent, charismatic, charming. And utterly lacking in morality.

"The, the boathouse." Jack wheezes. "They, they're in the boathouse. In a shipping container. Gohoohood luck though! Bonesaw has them, in pods. Take them out, and they die."

'Of course.' I can't help the sneer that spreads across my face. 'It can never be that easy.'

"Carol, would you kindly check the-"

"I'm not letting you out of my sight for a damned second so you best cut yourself off." I tell him.

"Well we can't very well leave him unattended." He says. "And we can't kill him, yet."

I roll my eyes and walk over, grab Jack by his hair and start dragging him. Only stopping when I feel him snagged on something. Looking back, I see his feet still impaled and nailed to the ground by the curves bones.

I give The Marquis a look. One he returns with an arrogant smile and a shrug.

"Seriously?" I ask, and he starts walking ahead of me. "Hey! John get back here!"

"Best hurry up my dear!" He snarks. "Lest I leave your sight."

Huffing, I look down to the half dead man. Chest skinned to hell and back. Feet impaled, hole in his left shoulder, right hand sliced off and cauterized, right side burned. I realize he's not going anywhere.

I spit on him before turning to follow The Marquis into the boathouse. The front side having a massive hole torn through it, right next to the door. That The Marquis promptly uses.

"Seriously?" I ask, not understanding the point.

"I'm not stepping through that." He shrugs as he holds the door open for me. "I might snag my clothes on the bent metal."

I feel my blood pressure rise at the sound of his smarmy tone. And in sheer, petty defiance I walk through the hole. And looking around the room, I form a sword in my hand as I spot the dangling form of Mannequin. Slumped over a laptop at a table as though he were unconscious. The remnants of a game of Monopoly in front of him.

"Is he-" I don't get to finish my question as a bone spike shoots straight up out of the floor, through the table and laptop in an instant. Impaling Mannequin's head. "-dead."

The Marquis walks past, not even sparing the table a second glance as he heads for the shipping containers at the far end of the room. Seven containers, and two are already open.

"Which one-" I start to say before I'm cut off again by several spikes of bone shooting through the floor. Tearing into the doors of the containers. "… you're doing that on purpose."

"Maybe." He says casually as he walks down the line of containers, and stares into the fourth one down.

Walking behind him, I stop at the second container. Housing a young girl I don't recognize. Her chest split open with several bits of machinery and wires attached. Her organs on full display, her heart still beating.

My face twists in disgust at the morbid sight. And I pray the same hasn't happened to Mark and Amy.

Walking to the next one, my fears are immediately proven true as I cover my mouth in horror. Mark, strapped up against the back of the container with his scalp removed, a glass container encasing his head. A respirator and several wires coming out from his chest.

"No." The word leaves my mouth of its own accord.

I don't dare to even approach him. My fear of messing something up, accidently tripping, or the container being rigged leaves me paralyzed.

"Please." The words leave my lips with a hoarse croak. "Please tell me Amy isn't."

I can't even finish the sentence.

The Marquis doesn't answer me. Instead, I hear the soft pats of his feet as he walks away.

"I… suppose I'll find out." He says calmly.

"What?" I ask as I manage to tear my eyes away from my husband's mutilated body.

He doesn't answer me again as he slowly walks towards the door.

"Gully!" We both flinch at the sound. "Jenny!"

Recognizing the voice, I break into a sprint. Leaving the boathouse through the hole and looking around the dockyard. The clouds are gathering as the sun sets, and a few drops of rain are starting to fall. But the thing that catches my attention, is Firebreather holding Gully in his arms. Kneeling in a pool of blood as he frantically looks between Gully and Jenny.

"Fire!?" I call out as I jog over to him, earning his attention.

"Carol?" He asks with furrowed brows. "What are you… that doesn't matter! We need to get Gully and Jenny help!"

Looking down, I recognize the two girls. The metallic teen, and the Amazonian girl. Realizing that in my rush to get to Jack earlier, I failed to recognize them.

"Fuck!" I curse as I kneel beside Gully and place a finger to her carotid.

…

…

Bump

"She's still alive." I say as I look her over and take in the injuries as the rain starts to pick up from light drops, to a soft misting.

A deep gash in her shoulder, and two deep gashes on her ankles. Likely severing her Achilles tendons and causing her to bleed out.

Bleeding she had since I first got here.

"She's, not-"

I flinch as I hear the sharp tearing of metal.

Looking behind me, a light spear already in hand. I watch as The Marquis walks out from behind a container, looking out towards the distance. A sour look on his face as he runs a hand through his hair. Staring down at the ground in the distance.

"What?" I bite out, partially irritated at being interrupted, partially grateful.

"He got away." He says in a low tone.

'What!?' I shoot up.

"What do you mean he got away?" I ask as I march towards him.

The frizzy, brown haired man points to the ground in the distance. And I follow his gesture, spotting a series of bloody footprints leading out to the road. Slowly being washed away by the rain.

"From what I can tell." The Marquis takes a deep breath. "He took a knife and wedged the hilt into his stump of a wrist. And used that to cut through the bones in his feet."

"Mmrrrrr, Fuck!" I curse as I turn and toss my spear at a nearby container. The weapon of light tearing right through and to the other side of the container before lodging itself in the container wall behind it.

"Jack got away?" Fire asks, still on the ground about ten feet from us. "After all that? All the effort and planning?"

That brings an important thought to mind.

"Fire, what are you doing here?" I question the orange man.

His eyes widen slightly, swallowing a lump in his throat as he looks away.

"We, we were going to try and take out the Nine." He says softly. "Kitsu already got rid of most of them so-"

"How would you know that?" I cut him off, my years of picking apart other's statements honing in on his words immediately.

Kitsu only killed Shatterbird. If she killed any others, it's not publically known.

"Um, she got ahold of us and-"

"When!?" I march over to the boy.

"A-about two or three days ago and-" He stutters out nervously.

"And you didn't think to tell me!?" I ask. If he had a shirt, I'd be grabbing him by the collar and holding him up by it. "Her mother!? Who's been looking for her for weeks!?"

"W-well she had good reason to not-"

"Where is she?" I demand to know as I grab his neck anyway.

Kitsu POV

"Is he?" I ask with a raised brow. Not willing to be direct with Bonesaw in the room.

"No, he wasn't there." Firebreather says, downtrodden and defeated as he averts his eyes from mine.

I sigh and pull out my phone. Dialing Hellfire's number I had Wade acquire for me.

"Time for plan T then." I huff out as I cross an arm under my chest and put the phone to the side of my head.

"Wait, what was plan B, and all the others?" Fire asks.

"A bomb under the docks." I shrug.

"What!?" Pinky asks, mortified by the idea.

"Then why call it plan B?" Bonesaw asks.

"It's starting to make sense now." Firebreather says as he crosses his arms.

Ignoring them, I hear the phone finally pick up.

"Look I don't have Medicare, I didn't order a laptop from Walmart, and I know I have outstanding charges and no I will not pay them." I hear Hellfire's voice say.

"What?/What?" Firebreather and Hellfire say at the same time.

Kitsu POV

.

Touching down on the concrete, I keep my illusionary umbrella up and protecting me from the rain as I carry Bonesaw behind me on an iridescent saucer. Still trapped in the bars of the cot I bent around her and keeping her with me. She may be disarmed, but I don't trust her for a second.

I look around the dockyard, noticing a few overturned containers. A collapsed crane and several bloodstains slowly being washed away by the rain.

Looking over to the boathouse where I hear the most sound. I make my way over, Bonesaw in tow as I refuse to allow her out of my perception.

Stepping up to the hole torn in the side of the boathouse, I feel a grin spread across my face as I see mother pacing back and forth at a table.

"Mommy!" I shout and run over to Mom with my arms wide open. But, just as I get close to her.

Smack!

"Ooww!" I'm stopped in my tracks by a sharp slap on my cheek. Holding said throbbing cheek, I look up to my mother. Her face borderline apocalyptic with rage as she glares. And she lunges forward.

"Ah!" Bonesaw squeals as I lose focus and drop her.

Mom, wraps her arms tightly around me.

"Never, never do that again little girl." She says with a quiet, shaky voice. "Do you understand? I don't care if you're immortal. I don't care if you can fight Endbringers one on one."

"What?" The frizzy haired man says softly.

"You never run off like that again." Mom starts crying. "I, I, I love you too much to think about losing you."

That, that breaks my heart. And I bring my arms up to hug her back. Not really being able to say anything in my defense as Mom cries on my shoulder.

"I'm sorry." Is the only thing I can manage to choke out to the woman who, reluctantly, took me in and became a mother to me.

"Oh trust me." She says, and I feel her smile against my shoulder. "You will be."

"Huh?"

"You, you are soooohohohoho grounded when we get home." She says shakily.

'Darn it!'

"Can we get a pizza before we get home?" I ask.

Hey, if I'm going into confinement, I might as well get a last meal. Priorities people you know what I'm about.

"We have pizza at home." She says and lets go of me. Standing up straight as she wipes her eyes. Immediately going back to resting bitch face as she turns to the frizzy haired man who starts walking towards us.

"So, you're the infamous Endstopper?" The victorian looking man says.

Like, he just has a look about him. Like he's from a period drama or something.

I go to call him out on his fashion, but mom steps in front of me. Putting herself between me and the man. Causing me to lean over so I see him.

"I must say, aside from the obvious, she's the spitting image of you." The man smiles at me. "Minus the hair and eye color."

The mention of resemblance causes something to click in my head. And I recognize his resemblance to Amy. Coupled with the fact that Ebon was supposed to be locked away in the Birdcage. Two plus two equals family reunion.

…

I need sleep.

"You don't get to talk to her." Mom says as she puts a hand back to move me, hiding him from my sight once more.

We stare each other down for what feels like hours. But is only a few seconds. Before the arrogant villain sighs and turns back towards the containers in the room.

The containers I've been ignoring.

"Kitsu, how confidant are you in your biokinesis?" The Marquis asks as he steps in front of Amy's shipping container, currently closed to avoid looking at her mutilated form.

"Depends on what we're talking about." Kitsu says dubiously. "Why?"

"Forget that!" Jenny says, having been off to the side the whole time. Only waking up a few minutes before Kitsu got here. "You need to help Gully!"

Looking over, I see the frantic robot girl. Worry scaring her face as she gestures to the large, pale girl.

"She's dead." The Marquis says callously. "Leave her be."

I look away. Not having the heart to-

"Puhhh!" I look over and see Gully snap her eyes open and gasp. Still pale, but quickly regaining some color to her face as she gasps for air. "Oh, oh god what happened?"

The Marquis steps aside to make way for Kitsu. A pensive look on his face as he slowly walks my way while Jenny cries over Gully.

"What did I just see?" He asks softly.

'And she was bleeding out when we got here.' Is what goes unsaid, but I've no doubt he put the math together.

Gully's been dead for nearly half an hour.

"I don't know what you're insinuating." I say softly.

I'm silent as Kitsu rips open Amy's container and steps in.

"Bonesaw!" Kitsu yells, poking her head out of the container and leveling a glare at me, or rather the little girl behind me. "You promised not to harm them!"

"They're not hurt!" She defends and huffs. "Nothing I did can't be undone by me."

"Yeah well, I'mma undo it." Kitsu says and heads inside the container.

"Nuh-uh!" Bonesaw, calls Kitsu's bluff? "You only do plants! How are you going to-"

"Ha!" Bonesaw calls out.

"What did you do!?" I run over, only to have a black illusionary wall put between me and the doors of the container.

"Nothing!" Kitsu yells frantically. "Just uh, nothing! I fixed it!"

"I'm going to have a heart attack." I say as I put my hands in my hair, feeling several hairs turn gray as I listen to the wet, squelches coming from inside the container. Unable to step away.

"You know." I hear behind me, and turn to the blonde girl with heterochromia. "I could easily undo their conditions."

"Bonesaw, I will stab you again!" Kitsu yells.

"Untie me!" Bonesaw screams and starts kicking her feet. Trying to stand up and rolling on the floor.

"Okay!" I see a soaked Firebreather touch down outside the boathouse. Panting as he steps inside and doubles over. "Whew! Man she's fast."

Bonesaw rolls over to him, and bites his ankle.

Firebreather stares down at her. A flat look on his face as she gnaws.

"You know what?" He says as he starts walking, the little girl getting dragged with him. "I don't care."

I wish I could just do that.

"Fixed it!" Kitsu says as she drops the barrier, allowing me to look as-

I throw up as I see her covered in blood.

"Don't worry!" Kitsu says. "It's not mine."

That's what I was afraid of.

-East Slums, October 3rd, 11:43pm-

Jack Slash POV

.

Limping down the alleyway, I curse everything that's happened lately. I curse the city, I curse my string of luck, I curse the fox and I curse those damned heroes in New Wave.

'This is, is nothing.' I tell myself. 'I can come back from this. This is just a lull, a beat back before the inevitable return for the final act.'

I need to find a place. Rest up and heal. My hand is gone, but a half decent prosthetic shouldn't be too hard to obtain. My shoulder, I might need to be more careful not to use and make sure I don't mess with it. My chest, fuck my chest burns in this rain. But, I have the undermesh acting as a skin. So I should be fine.

My thoughts are cut off by a deafening bang as I fall over onto the wet ground. Screaming out involuntarily as my skinned chest scrapes on the dirty ground.

My heart pounds as I breathe heavily from the pain. Not knowing what hit me as I feel a dull pain in the back of my head.

"I swear." I hear a younger, softer male voice behind me. "Nothing is ever easy."

Looking back, I feel my heart thud as I see the slim figure. His form is blacked out by the rain, but it's clear he's aiming a gun at me.

"Wh-who are you?" I ask as I move to get back up as the figure starts to walk closer. The subtle wet splashes of his steps sounding far louder than I know they are. His thin, unassuming figure looking like death incarnate as he approaches and his features become clearer. "Wait, are you-"

He aims the gun at my forehead and fires. Knocking me back as the bullet is stopped by the undermesh.

"Ah, ah." I let out rasps of pain as I feel the worst headache I've ever known wrack my brain.

"You don't get to say our name." He says, his green eyes seeming to glow with a toxic indifference of disgust. Looking at me the way one would a dead and rotting dog.

He kicks me over to my chest, causing another round of scorching pain. My face splashing into a puddle.

I try to push up, but I get shoved back into the puddle.

.

.

3rd person POV

.

Jack's face is pushed back into the shallow puddle. The black haired young man pressing a foot to the back of Jack's head. Keeping his face in the puddle.

"Hurry up and die." The young man says without a trace of empathy for the killer thrashing beneath his foot. Deciding that if he can't make it quick with a gun, he might as well make it slow. Choosing to drown the man in a two inch puddle. "And think about every life you've ever taken and ruined. Think, think real hard."

Small motes of green electricity can be seen as the man presses down harder on Jack's head. Ensuring he has no chance of overpowering his attacker. Still, Jack, for all his proposed theatrics and philosophy on the roles of life and death, doesn't want to die.

"Think about the mother's you've left to cry over their children." The man says through gritted teeth as he brings his foot slightly, only to stomp back down on the mutilated man beneath him. "Think of the father's who've had to bury their own blood." Again. "Think of the children you've orphaned and scarred! Of the friends who'll never get to share another tale with one another! Of the brothers and sisters forced to outlive their siblings!" He accentuates every line with another stomp to the back of Jack's head. Crushing the man's face flat and bloody against the pavement.

Jack thrashes as much as he can. But with no blades and no fully functioning limbs, it becomes clear how futile his struggle is.

"Die." The green eyed man says and presses down harder, a nasty snarl plastered on his face as he regards the scum stuck to his shoe.

And as if on command, Jack stops struggling. His body slowly loosing its fight as life leaves his eyes. The man slipping into unconsciousness, due to lack of air. Before, after ten agonizing minutes. He passes out, and breathes in. Inhaling the muddy water of the puddle he's held down in.

Dead.

The man stays there for another ten minutes. Not moving or cutting off his power until he's sure Jack is dead. Taking his foot off the back of his head.

He stands there, staring at the dead body as the rain falls.

"Heh." He gives a weak chuckle as he stares at the corpse. "Heh ha. I, I did it. I did it again. But, it's okay right? He was bad, he was evil. Yes he was. He killed so many people. What's one life, compared to the countless thousands, millions I just saved? You don't need to ask. You did a good thing." He says, his tone changing with each sentence.

The man turns around, choosing to believe the voices. Telling himself that he did the right thing. That sometimes, you need to do bad in order to do good. Or was it one of the voices saying that?

It's getting harder for him to tell anymore. As with every act, every instance he gives in. A little more of the man, Izuku, dies to make room for The Butcher.

A/N

The reason the Butcher went after Jack himself, is due to Jack targeting their next intended host. Kitsu.

.

So, I was originally going to write that Amy dies, and The Marquis returns to Villainy as a result.

But, certain events pushed me to go for a more, happy ending. Mostly that a fan of mine just lost a friend and I didn't want them to be sadder.

Not just because of that reason, but also because I had entire dissertations sent to me explaining why I shouldn't kill off Mark or Amy. So, straw that broke the camel's back and all that.

.

Strongest members of The Newest Wave

1 Ben: Ben's versatility is only limited by his ego. Being a Tinker/Breaker 12 will do that. Problem is, he has the bite to match his bark. So when his ego gets him into trouble, it's usually something BIG.

2. Jenny: Jenny is not only strong and durable, she's versatile. However, she's unaware of just all she's capable of. Only really understanding that she's powerful, and most people aren't. Leading her to having the opposite problem as Ben and overestimate herself.

3. Firebreather: A bit dull in the head. Firebreather knows he's strong, but is down to earth and knows his limits and the limits of those around him. Which ironically makes him a more formidable fighter than Ben or Jenny.
.

Also, a bit surprised no one mentioned how Ben had a little PTSD moment last chapter. Covered in blood and telling himself it wasn't a person, just a zombie.
I mostly added this line because for some reason ffn and qq track word count differently. So here's the last bit to get them even.

A/N Rocky Road

Alt title: Grand Ace 4 wins the NEWB Trivia game!

.

Master: Upon being killed, will have their powers and subconscious transferred to their killer. If the killer isn't a parahuman, then it moves to the closest parahuman.

Personal profile

Born Izuku Midoriya on Japan's mainland in 1988. Leviathan's attack on Kyushu had a rippling effect on Japan's economic and social stability. In the chaos left in the wake of Kyushu sinking, Inko Midoriya assumed the identity of her friend, Mitsuki Bakugo, who had died in Leviathan's attack alongside her husband and child. And furthered the deception by claiming Izuku as Bakugo. Using the combined assets of her and her dead friend, she fled to America in hopes of a better life.

This series of events deeply scarred Izuku. Not the least of which was from the fact he had to play the role of his dead friend for years in order to avoid deportation. It is around this time that Izuku triggered with a Trump power.

Eventually, while attending therapy in San Franscico. The Teeth had passed through. Caught in a hostage situation, Izuku was forced to kill The Butcher in order to save a family from being gunned down.

His previously unknown power made itself known when he started hearing voices. Voices that drove him back to The Teeth where he has been fighting a losing battle in his head over the last five years.

Izuku is naturally kind hearted, but the death of his friend and subsequent uprooting of his life and need to assume his friend's identity have left him with a warped sense of self. Even before The Butcher, Izuku struggled with questions of identity.

RadChaos897: I blueballed the Taylor & The Undersiders interaction for 2 reasons.

One, it would make no sense for them to do a violence. The Undersiders are thieves, not thugs. And Tattletale is not only traumatized of Kitsu, but is heavily reliant on her power. And it's been established that when Taylor commandeers a power, she partially takes it from the primary user. It's why Hellfire lost the ability to control his flames until he was forced out of Taylor's range. So Tattletale was working on half a brain, and the speculations were running wild, so she panicked.

Reason 2! Writer's block… that's it.

But don't worry! I'll be sure to revisit it.

Kitsu wouldn't do anything that would require her to go into Mark and Carol's room. She holds the idea of personal and private space as sacred… so long as she cares about you. Strangers don't count.

What happened with Scarecrow is that he was disgusted by what was happening and left. (Also, he's gay. It just never comes up because there's never a situation for it to come up.) and the black guy dropped dead in a house of junkies, ergo he was looted.

That, that Kitsu/Missy/Vista idea you just had? I'm stealing that.

Taylor is going to walk down the sidewalk when she's 30 something, stop, sigh, and just recall the time she thought her best friend's sister and her dad were fucking. Such is life.

The reason I chose Kirsu, is because the R and T buttons on my phone are right next to each other, and I misspell Kitsu as Kirsu more often than I care to admit.

-Dallon House, Saturday, October 16th, 4:30pm-

.

.

Kitsu POV

.

"Kitsu, I'm calling in one of my favors." Wade says in a deathly serious tone. "I'm sending you and your family tickets to Hawaii."

…

"Okay I'mma need you to run that back on me." I mentally reel from blind shot I just took. "Come again?"

He just called. I mean, who starts a phone call like that? Wade's been watching too much Mission Impossible.

"One of the Chicago Wards went MIA on the coast of Kauai." Wade continues. "Myrrdin is paying me to locate her, and I'm running into a lot of road blocks on my end."

"Wade, I get you take your side job seriously but- hang on." I say as I put him on hold and reactivate my stream. "Sorry about that you fleas, but something's come up and I'll need to reschedule. Bye!"

Not caring to check the chat, I turn off the stream and go back to Wade.

"Okay where was I? Oh right. I can't just uproot and travel to the opposite end of the country. Practically the other side of the world at the drop of a hat." I tell him as I start pacing back and forth from my door to Amy's door. "I have a life here, one that includes school, a girlfriend, a family and even a Vicky."

She's good for makeup. Dean buys her the good brands.

"Kitsu, you owe me. Several times over." His voice goes uncharacteristically harsh. "I'm cashing it in and if I need to I'll cash in more."

I click my tongue as I lean to one side. Hand on my hip as I tap my foot in thought.

"I'd love to, Wade." I shrug. "But my tail is tied. It's not up to me it's up to-"

Click.

"-Rude." I scoff at the phone. Heading to my room and deciding to burn the day by abusing my limited phone time privileges with some anime.

Getting past my door, I stretch my arms above my head. Then, putting a little power into my legs, I leap forward and plop face first on my bed.

"Kitsu!" I flinch, my back and tail going straight as I hear Mom shout my name.

"I didn't do it!" I push up and shout back reflexively.

"Get down here!" She shouts anyway, not believing me for some reason.

"Why don't you come up here!?" I say stupidly, panicking as I try to think of what I could've done in the past twenty four hours to get me in trouble.

"If I have to go up there to get you then you can forget about the photoshoot or being allowed to go trick or treating!" She shouts back. "Now get down here!"

'Not my candy!' I think in horror at the aspect of not being able to pilfer as many diabetes sticks as possible.

I get up and push off the bed. Taking a breath, I summon an illusionary mirror and check my reflection. Getting ready to put on my cutest I'm sorry face. Will it work? Not on Mom. But it might work on Dad and get him to intervene.

'And hug your tail.' I think to myself as I quickly check my appearance. 'Good enough.'

Quickly running down the stairs, I make it into the dining room where Mom has made a makeshift home office to do her work. Said worker giving me an annoyed glare as she stands in the middle of the room with her hand on her hip, right hand up and holding her phone.

"Care to tell me why I have an info broker bribing me to go to Hawaii?" She asks in a soft voice that promises nothing but pain for me.

'Damnit Wade!' I mentally curse.

"Uh… no?" I say precariously, then turn and bolt as soon as I see her face grow a shade deeper. "Daddy! Help!"

I run into the hall, through the living room where Amy is still watching TV. And hook a left into the kitchen, where Dad is not.

"Kitsu!" I hear Mom following after me.

"Kitchen." Amy rats me out.

"Aaah!" I scream in panic as I race into the downstairs bathroom and lock the door. Before crawling onto the toilet and the opening then window above said toilet as a back up escape in case she has keys.

"Kitsu you better open this damn door!" Mom yells as the doorknob wiggles furiously.

"I'm naked!" I shout as I look out the window and spot Dad in the back yard.

I kind of panicked and ran in here on a whim. Fully expecting Dad to be in the kitchen.

"If you are then you better bet that your phone is gone!" Mom says. "Do not think for a second that nudity will save you young lady, now who are you talking to!?"

Out of context that sentence is horrifying.

"Ish sprieken ingles nicht!" I shout in broken German as I crawl out the window and drop into the back yard. Where I land on my hands and knees. Looking up and spotting Dad roasting hot dogs over a fire just as I recognize the scent of cooking meat.

"What did you do this time?" He asks with a flat look.

'Now's your chance!' I tell myself. 'Take it you fool!'

"Uh…" I get up and give him my cute little girl look, hugging my tail and everything. "Nothing~, what are you doing?"

'You know.' Another part of my panicked mind speaks up. 'Depending on how this turns out, this could become a cautionary tale on the dangers of doubling down!'

I hate how my mind will get snarky with me.

"Barbeque." He says, putting down a poker with a hotdog on it as I hear the door to the bathroom open in the house behind me and Mom run in.

"Kitsu!" Mom yells from the small window behind me. "Get back in here right now or so help me god!"

It is now, that I realize.

I fucked up.

"Help!" I run towards Dad with my arms outstretched. "She's gone mad! It must be a master or a tinker device!"

I glomp onto him and shuffle behind the man, forcing him to be a meat shield between me and the angry woman's direction.

"Okay, seriously." Dad says as he stumbles to keep his footing while I hide behind him.

"It's true!" I whine. "She just started yelling at me and being mean!"

I cautiously peek from behind his legs, keeping my eyes on the backdoor in anticipation. Fearful of the incoming Endbringer.

And lo and behold.

"Kitsu!" She says as she marches out the backdoor with a red face. "Get out from behind your father and stand in front of me young lady!" She says as she stops halfway.

Young Lady is her equivalent of pulling the full name on me. You know what I mean.

"Move forward." I whisper as I nudge him.

"Oh no." He gives a nervous chuckle and steps away from me to grab a poker and stoke the bonfire. "You're on your own here- and I just shoved my hotdog in ash… great."

He sighs, completely unconcerned as he grabs the hotdog and pulls it off. Tossing it in the fire and grabbing another from an opened pack on the edge of the fire pit.

"How could you-" I start.

"Three!" Mom calls out, and I run over to stand in front of her. Where she grabs me by the ear!

"Hey, hey! Ow!" I cry out as she drags me back to the house. "This is uncalled for! Abuse! Ow!"

"You want to talk about uncalled for?" She hisses as she pushes me forward into the house, letting go of my ear. "Me getting a phone call from a kid in Chicago, trying to bribe me to go to Hawaii. And then having to chase you through the house! What were you thinking!?"

"You seemed mad." I defend weakly as I nurse my ear.

"And you thought making me chase you all over the place would make me less mad?" She leans down and whispers harshly.

I don't answer her as I keep my eyes to my fluff. Having greatly underestimated her irritation as I hold my tail. More out of insecurity than trying to be cute this time.

"Answer me young lady." Mom says sternly.

I can't think of anything to say. So, I just stand here awkwardly as she waits. Before I end up flinching when she sighs. Expecting a verbal lashing and maybe a slap.

Not that I think she'll hit me like that! But she seems mad enough to.

"Phone." She holds her hand out. "Now."

'Yeah, that's fair.' I think to myself as I reach into my pocket and set it in her hand.

"Password." She demands.

"What!?" I look up to her in disbelief as she keeps my phone open on the lock screen.

"Password, now." She repeats. "You don't want to tell me what's going on, that's fine. I'll find out myself."

"You promised you'd never go through my phone!" I protest, and jump up to reach my phone. Using my powers to grab it, only for Mom to refuse to let it go.

I have, pictures on there! Not that I send them to anyone or anything, but I like to make sure I look good. And, I like taking pictures.

Don't judge me!

"Then tell me what the hell is going on!" She demands as she holds onto the phone. "And knock it off!" She swats my hands.,

"Fine!" I say as I pull back. "It was Wade! I owe him a few favors and he's trying to cash one in!"

"Who the hell is Wade?" Mom asks, and slaps my hands off my phone.

"He's no one bad! He's just an info broker." I admit. "You might know him by the name Comms Guru. He has a long standing contract with Myrrdin."

"And why haven't I heard of him from you before now?" She asks, crossing her arms and looking down on me.

… Not that it means anything. Everyone older than me looks down on me.

"Well it's not like it's something that just comes up in conversation." I mutter.

Mom, still red faced, points down the hall.

"Go to the dining room and sit." She says.

"What about-"

"Don't push me right now." She glares. "And go!"

Carol "Brandish" Dallon POV

.

'Fuck!' I rub my temples as she runs off. 'It's Vicky all over again.'

"I'm getting too old for this." I groan as I take a deep breath to calm myself down. And begin pacing back and forth in the hall. Kitsu's phone still in my hand as I press my fingers to my temples.

I thought my days of parenting overactive and stubbornly independent girls was ending. Instead it seems I signed a renewal!

Ring!

I flinch at the sudden noise and look down to the phone in my hand. The ringing pink brick seeming to burn a hole on my hand. The caller I.D. reading Wade.

Taking a breath. I answer the phone.

"Hello?" I say.

"Brandish?" The voice of the adolescent boy comes through loud and clear. "I suppose that's good. Are you ready to hear me out?"

"That depends." I say, mentally preparing myself for the worst. "What does Kitsu owe you a favor for?"

"For this one? Erasing twelve different felonies from ever being placed on her." He answers.

That means nothing to me. She already had a litany of charges against her. From burglary, felony trespass, to grand theft auto. And if I'm being honest? Felony doesn't mean a whole lot. All it means is a crime with a sentence of a year or more in prison. You can get that for stealing a slice of pizza three times in some states. Which knowing Kitsu, that's likely what she did.

"Alright. First, tell me why I should even entertain the idea of uprooting my family for an undisclosed amount of time to an island halfway around the world." I say seriously. "And then I'll hear out on why I should leave my job under the same pretense and why I shouldn't just report you."

Not that I think reporting a tinker would do any good. If you could report them so easily then Toybox wouldn't exist.

"You have no current contracts at the moment. And if you do this, I'll owe you." He says.

Putting aside the fact he knows I'm between cases right now.

"That's a promise, not a reason." I point out.

"Fair enough. How about this, in a show of good faith. I'll erase the video of Manpower pressing the button." He says, causing me to freeze.

"You're bluffing." I call him out.

"My tinker specialty is in programming and communications technology. Setting a feeder virus out into the internet is easy for me. I've done it enough times that I can make one right now in two minutes." He claims. "I can't get rid of anything on any closed systems. But give it time, and Manpower's moment of weakness becomes hearsay."

'Don't do it Carol.' I tell myself as images of Neil and his family being left destitute by the allegations. Neil losing his job, Sarah becoming the sole provider. The movement being pushed back another decade by the scandal. 'If it ever got out, that's your career and the movement.'

"And how do I know you are who you say you are?" I ask tentatively.

"You can ask Dragon." He says. "Shouldn't the fact I know you're between cases be enough? This also isn't the first time I've helped you."

"And what is that supposed to mean?" I ask as I feel my blood run like ice in my veins.

"Well I'm not supposed to do this." The ice turns solid as I hear Dragon's voice.

The same voice that guided me and John to the boat graveyard.

-Arcadia High, Monday, October 18th, 12pm-

Missy "Vista" Biron POV

.

I sigh as I close my locker. And rest my head against the cool, painted metal as I groan. Tired from everything.

Turns out skipping a grade does not excuse you for minor things you miss. Like negative exponents and other stupid maths I'll never use in life. Heck , if I just keep at my career with the PRT I can have people do all the math stuff for me!

'You're sounding like mom.' I feel a small bubble of irritation rise up in me.

I should probably move on before I miss lunch. Or get in trouble for loitering in the halls.

I let out a tired sigh as I push off the locker and turn around. Catching just the barest hint of golden fur out the corner of my eye and the faint smell of strawberry shampoo.

"Behind you!" I hear her whisper.

Turning around, I watch as my girlfriend walks in the opposite direction towards the main foyer. Having gotten done with her only class for the day and heading home.

My eyes wander for a few seconds as I watch her go. Noticing she's putting an exaggerated sway in her steps. Likely to further get my attention. And after a long day? I quickly look back and forth down the hall, and upon not seeing anyone. I fall in step behind her.

"Hmm?" Her right ear perks up as she turns around and spots me a mere three feet behind her. Where I take a big step forward and grab her by the shoulders, pulling her into the tightest hug I can manage.

"Rmm?" She mutters against my chest, before returning the hug and nuzzling against me. Doing the thing she does where she pauses and sniffs me. Then, tilting her head up and smiling at me.

Feeling mischievous, I turn her and I corner her against the lockers. Putting a hand up to support myself and keep her from escaping as I leer down at her.

"Hey there stranger." Kitsu gives a shy smile. An adorable blush growing on her face as her tail swishes against the lockers behind her, knocking a few of the locks back and forth. "Can I help you?"

'God that sounds so corny.' I hold back a giggle.

"Yeah, you can tell me where you got so cute." I recite the pick up line I read online. Holding back the cringe I feel trying to force its way through to my face.

The cute girl's reddening face and swishing tail helps.

"I uh, I think I should warn you." Her voice cracks a little. "I-I have a girlfriend. In case you didn't know."

'This is so dumb!' It takes a lot out of me to focus on not laughing.

"Something tells me she doesn't mind you talking to me." I say as I bring my free hand over to hold her by the small of her back. "And something tells me you like it."

"Mrrrrrmmmm!" She clenches her eyes shut with a squeal as her tail swishes up a storm. Face redder than an apple.

Taking advantage of the moment of solitude, and her current state of being flustered. I pull her towards me, chest to chest as our lips smash together. Making my girlfriend throw her arms around my neck and lean into the kiss.

"Mwah." I pull back, enjoying her embarrassment and unable to keep the no doubt dopey grin off my face. "See? Seems to me like you like this."

"Mrrrmm!" She squeals, trembling in my arms before stomping her foot. "When did you get to be the suave one?"

"When you decided to be so fun to tease." I tease her.

"Well that's not my fault." She pouts playfully as she looks up to me. Separating with a huff as she crosses her arms, but can't keep the smile off of her face.

"Well it has to be someone's." I brush a lock of hair behind my ear as I lean in and whisper. "And it's not mine." I leave a small kiss on her nose.

She tilts her head up quickly and blows. Making me flinch back and turn away to sneeze as air shoots straight up my nostrils.

"Ugh!" I cover my nose. "You're such a little brat!" I can't help but laugh out.

"Hey!" We freeze and turn our heads to the end of the hall towards the art teacher, Mr. Callies as he leans out of his classroom.

Me and Kitsu stare at him with wide eyes. Realizing that we got caught.

"You." He points to Kitsu. "Home, shoo. You have one class here, you." He points to me. "Go to lunch."

He heads back into his class. Leaving me red faced and mortified as I contemplate which hole I should crawl into to die. Currently banking on Winslow, but I think I can do better than that gang recruitment facility.

"Well, um." Kitsu is the first to break the silence. "So uh, see you later?"

"Uh, sure." I say awkwardly and start walking away.

"Oh!" She appears in front of me with a gust of wind. "I almost forgot to mention, we uh, we as in everyone in the house. We're heading out of town for a bit."

"What?" I feel part of my brain stumble a bit, having not expected that.

"Now suffer in curiosity." She grins deviously, leaping up to leave a soft kiss on my cheek before disappearing in a gust of wind as she super speeds down the hall.

…

"I'll just ask Vicky at lunch." I shrug and turn around.

-Arcadia High, Monday, October 18th, 12:30pm-
