3rd Person POV, With Fire and Crystal

.

"At this rate we'll need to call in an Endbringer attack!" Crystal yells as she flies beside Firebreather. Slowing her own flight to stay close to her injured boyfriend.

"Why haven't they called it yet?" Fire asks as he powers through the pain of using his wings with an exposed shoulder and the various lacerations.

She couldn't tell him. It's not even like New Wave is the first on sight. Armsmaster and Dauntless are here. Though she hadn't seen much of the greek themed hero. For all his popularity, he doesn't seem to actually do much in major battles.

'It's his calves.' Laserdream tells herself. 'Gotta be.'

In a few more moments, Laserdream and Firebreather make it back to the street. If it can be called that as it's nearly completely ruined. A fact that gets punctuated as the monster is slammed into a building by the newer monster. The tentacles of the black creatures lower half wrapping around and strangling the various heads of the main monster.

As they fly over and spot Dragon and Armsmaster on a roof, overlooking the battle of titans. The black monster slams Echidna into the building they're against, collapsing the structure under the force and weight.

"This is getting out of hand, and fast." Crystal says as they descend to meet with Armsmaster and Dragon.

Armsmaster turns to look at the approaching heroes, making note of Firebreather's very visible state of distress. His brow furrowing under his helm as he regards the hero.

"I had believed you'd be smart enough to leave." He says with a frown. "Especially after you nearly got yourself killed."

"Armsmaster." Dragon's suit, model Firesuit, echoes its creator's voice. Turning its armored 'head' to the man. Before addressing the two. "Firebreather, are you certain you should be fighting?"

"I'm tougher than I look." Fire gives a convincing smile, before turning to the scene of destruction. "Besides, we have bigger issue than how I feel."

"Please don't say that." Dragon's voice echoes, earning a bit of respect from Crystal. "But as for the current issue, we're waiting for further developments while the PRT calls in help."

"What do you mean?" Crystal asks, her brow furrowing in disbelief as she looks between the fight and the world class Tinker. "Are they calling in an Endbringer event?"

"No." Armsmaster says. "We're waiting to see how this fight plays out. If the second creature is trying to kill the first, then anything we do will only get in its way."

"That, and getting involved now might turn both creature's attention towards us." Dragon explains further. "In which case an Endbringer alarm is-"

Kakaaaaaak!

The air rings and shakes with the force of a jet breaking the sound barrier. Making Fire and Crystal flinch as Armsmaster instinctively reaches for his halberd, that isn't their.

Not a second later and a building down the street collapses in on itself. Earning everyone's attention, even the second monster as it looks to the building. Leaving the first one behind it as it races for the destroyed structure.

But it is that moment of distraction, that moment that allows the original beast of amalgamated flesh to turn the tables. One of the large wolf heads lashes out, using its elongated neck to turn around and grab onto one of the black beast's lower tendrils. Pulling it back and slamming it into the street, ripping the tendril from its body. The black beast going still before slowly dispersing into motes of dust.

Leaving the fleshy monster to its own as it lets out a roar of satisfaction. An expression of emotion and intelligence that hints at a mind behind the destruction.

"Well there goes that." Crystal mutters as behind the beast, one of its mouths wretches and hurls up two figures. A shapely blonde woman, and an armored hulk of a person.

"Oh, fucking hell." Fire groans as he notices the same.

"I've been able to determine the factor behind the creature's cloning." Armsmaster says as he opens a pad on his gauntlet and checks something and goes to check his boot.

"Yeah, and what's tha- Agh!" Firebreather rears back in pain as Armsmaster removes a syringe from an armored compartment on his calf and jabs it into Fire's exposed shoulder muscle. "Dick! What was that for!"

"Col-Armsmaster!" Dragon hisses while keeping watch on the new clones as one flies off and the other… digs under ground.

Laserdream rushes forward and flips midair to plant both feet on Armsmaster's chest. Pushing him back as she throws up a shield and checks on her boyfriend.

"The hell was that for!?" Fire bares his teeth at the armored tinker.

"If you're going to insist on being here then I might as well make you less of a liability." He coldly says as he deposits the syringe back into the compartment on his calf. "You're not healed, but the pain should numb itself in a moment."

"You prick!" Crystal turns to the tinker, lowering her shield to address him. "We don't know how he'll react to-to what that was!"

"Crystal, it's fine." Fire says softly as he puts a hand on her shoulder, but maintains a glare at the PRT hero. "It's actually working." He lies to calm her down.

"You can thank me later." Armsmaster says as he holds his hand and a new halberd appears in his grasp. "Right now we need to keep the monster contained as best we can while backup arrives."

.

.

-With the new clones-

.

'Being born a few moments ago is… odd. Given that I have most of my memories from before I was made.' Gully's clone contemplates as she looks for clothes to cover up in. 'Not that my blueprint could claim the same.'

Standing hunched over with broad shoulders and a frame that screamed bulk. Where Gully was over six feet, this girl was over nine. Not that you could tell she was a girl with her tannish grey armored hide of a skin. Looking more like an upright rhino with a wide faced human head. Sporting four fingers as opposed to five.

"Wreck the buildings." The clone of Laserdream says as she fixes the bloody black jacket on herself. Looking much the same as her own blueprint, if a tad off. Slightly shorter with slimmer legs, eyes a shade off and hair a shade brighter.

"But I haven't found anything to wear-" The larger starts to protest.

"Don't care!" She flips her hair as she struts through the clothing store. "Just do, Dilo."

"It's Gorver." The newly named clone growls down at her.

"You're whatever the fuck I wanna call you." She turns to the armored girl with a smirk. "Sorry hun, but the morbidly freakish don't get a say in how people see them."

"Big talk from someone a tenth my size." Gorver tells the five and a half foot girl as she stands at her nine foot plus height. Her bald head breaking the ceiling above her.

"Aw, it's cute that you think that means something." She clicks her tongue.

"Girls, girls, you're both pretty." Blastzone says as he steps away from a clothing rack in a pair of black jeans.

"Speaking of freaks." Crystal rolls her eyes in disgust.

"Yeah yeah get it out of your system." He says as he cracks his neck and looks to Gorver. "Take your time." He turns back to the unnamed clone. "Ray, you're with me."

"Who gave you the right to name me?" The girl crosses her arms and glares at the reptilian clone as he walks towards her. "What, just because you got a big dick means you can boss- huuhh!" She doubles over as Blastzone delivers a right hook to her gut. Reaching an arm around her back to pull her close as he speaks into her ear.

"I'm the boss, because I fucking said so." He whispers. "Now get out there, and help me kill the pathetic little heroes camping across the street. Got it?"

He punctuates his point by pressing the tip of his tail into her thigh. Digging it in just enough to go through the purple leggings she found and draw blood from her skin.

"Y-yes." She lets out a strangled reply.

"Good girl." Blastzone says as he lets up and steps back. Giving her a condescending smile as he ruffles her hair. Before dropping the pretense and shoving her towards the door. "Go."

Ray flies out of the thrift shop, both eager to vent her anger and get away from the tyrant Blastzone.

He may be the strongest of them, and the oldest. But that doesn't mean she has to like him. Ray flies up and spots the armored tinker that she knows is Armsmaster. And from what she can recall of the memories gifted to her, she found the perfect target to vent on.

Honing in on the hero as he runs across the rooftops, she throws her hands out and unleashes a fiery laser that nails the man in the back as he nears a ledge. Scorching his back and making him stumble forth.

Turning around to confront the threat, Ray flies over Armsmaster's head and blasts him from above. Grinning as she sees his helm smoke from the heat of her lasers. The blue varnish evaporating with a chemical smell that burns the nose hairs.

"You're not Laserdream." He notes as he turns to her, his suit's internals picking up on the subtle differences in her appearance. As well as picking up on the fact that her lasers burn more than push.

"No shit." Ray scoffs, raising a purple shield that follows her hand as Armsmaster throws his halberd. Batting the weapon aside with an almost disrespectful ease as she hovers in place. Hand on her hip as she stares down at him. "Want to try that again?" She says with a patronizing tone.

"If you're offering." He says as the halberd teleports to his hand.

Ray prepares a shield, before a searing pain courses through her. Making her yelp in shock as she stumbles forward.

Dauntless was moving to meet up with Armsmaster and had noticed the scuffle. And rather than wait things out, had taken action. Running over to the building behind Ray and extended his Arclance. Striking the clone with an electrically charged energy spear.

Not one to waste an opportunity, Armsmaster throws his halberd. Ray raises her hand to make a shield and protect herself, but the weapon releases an electrical pulse before it gets near her. Sending more electricity out and into her. Making her seize under the constant assault.

"Back off!" Blastzone comes in from the side and barrels into Armsmaster, carrying him off the side of the building. Laying into the Tinker and throwing him to the ground below as his chest glows green with a building energy blast.

"No you." Blastzone hears as a robotic voice as he's tackled from the side by a tall feminine robot. Dragon's firesuit having slammed him away.

Blastzone looks to the robotic combatant and unleashes the charge he was building for Armsmaster. Grinning as the shot hits point blank, but the grin is short lived as an arm swings around and clamps down around him.

"Unfortunately for you." Dragon's unnaturally cold voice comes through as she takes them up and out of the smoke cloud. "This suit was made with extreme heat and ballistics in mind."

Blastzone tries again, only this time he lets his charge build up.

Figuring out his plan, Dragon tightens her hold on Blastzone. His back popping and forcing him to unleash his blast early. All while Dragon flies them higher and higher.

"It may take a minute, but I've deemed you the biggest threat." Dragon says, letting a bit of meanness show in her voice as she flies higher faster. "So we're going to test your lung's efficiency. How high do you think you can breath?"

Back on the ground, or rather the rooftops. Armsmaster manages to get stop his fall. Inversing the teleporter matrix on his halberd and tossing it to the roof. Making him land in front of Dauntless just in time to catch a punch from Ray.

Armsmaster squeezes her fist in his hand, cracking and breaking her fingers under the cold metal. Ray screams in pain as she fires a laser from the broken appendage. Forcing Armsmaster to let go as his suit takes damage from the heat. The joints of his fingers sparking as he pulls back.

Dauntless stands beside Armsmaster as the two need no communication to act. Both men thrusting their weapons into the clone and electrocuting her simultaneously. Sending her back as she convulses on the roof.

Dazed and only faintly aware of her surroundings. Ray gets afloat as she tries to flee. But only gets a few feet before a blast of concussive force to her back sends her sprawling to the street below.

Crystal descends from above with a sneer as she watches her clone fall. Having noticed the commotion, she rushed ahead of Firebreather to intercept and get the drop on the imitation.

"Okay, so how do we handle these things?" Dauntless asks.

"I say we put them down." Crystal says before angling herself down and shooting after her clone.

"Laserdream!" Armsmaster shouts. "You need to focus on the main threat!"

But she wasn't listening. Her mind made up to destroy her clone before she does or says something that can't be undone. Motivated by part self preservation, part vanity and insult at having a copycat. Crystal throws out her hands and fires at her clone, intent on forcing her to meet the ground faster.

Only for her clone to expertly flip around mid fall and correct her flight. Throwing up a shield to stop the blast long enough to move out of the way. The laser hitting the sidewalk below with no consequence as Ray lets Crystal overtake her to attack her from behind.

Feeling an unnatural hatred for her original. Ray opts to not use her lasers and just grabs onto Crystal from behind.

"Ah!" Crystal cries out as Ray balls up her hair in a fist and forces her to stare at the ground as she adds her own flight powers to force them down.

"Smile!" Ray says with an elated grin. "I want to see if the blood splatter will show it."

"Like hell!" Crystal shouts as she pulls up while entering a corkscrew to throw the clone off.

She succeeds in slowing down significantly, but not in throwing Ray off of her as they hit the pavement with a wet crack. Crystal's face hitting the ground first, followed by Ray's knees.

Crystal's head is thrown back. Snapping her neck at an angle and ending her life instantly.

Ray floats away and curses under the pain of her scrapped and likely broken knees. Turning around to look at her original.

"You know." She says as she inspects Crystal's prone, unmoving form laying face down on the ground. The concrete around her head slowly growing shiny under the moonlight as blood pools under her. "It's a shame, I mean with an ass like that? Hate to see it go." She smirks in self satisfaction. "Good thing there's another to make up for the loss."

Ray allows the moment of satisfaction to wash over her. Taking a sick and twisted form of pride in having killed off her original, whereas Blastzone had failed to do the same.

Stumbling back, Ray holds her side as the moment fades alongside the adrenaline. The pain of everything she just endured flooding into her. From the skinning of her knees to the burning numbness where she was electrocuted.

"CRYSTAL!" Ray looks up to see the descending form of Firebreather.

"Oh good." Ray groans in frustration.

Firebreather pays the clone no attention as he scoops up Crystal and immediately flies off. Cradling his girlfriend in his arms as he flees the scene. Leaving Ray to consider her options.

She's in no position to really fight. But at the same time, if she doesn't do something to draw attention then her maker might be put on the chopping block. And Firebreather is no doubt about to come back with a vengeance.

As much as she'd love to ruin the freak further, she needs to prioritize. Find Gorver and any other possible siblings. Then make an actual plan of attack.

.

.

Firebreather desperately flies as fast as he can. Getting Crystal as far from the fight as possible before setting her down on a roof in the commercial district.

"Fuck, fuck, fuck." He curses as he moves a hand to her neck, checking for a pulse.

…

He waits, hoping it's just faint.

…

But with every second that passes, his own heart beats faster. Almost as though to compensate, as though it could beat for two.

"No… no, no no no no." Firebreather heaves as his chest tightens in pain. Images of another, a dark haired woman laying cold on the ground. Memories of the past coming back.

"No. No!" Fire grabs his head, stumbling back and trying desperately to hold back the tears.

Fire floods his vision as dark haired woman reaches for him.

"Duncan!"

"NO!" He screams, his chest glowing in response to his stress.

"Duncan run!"

"NO!" He screams as the memory leaves just as soon as it flooded his mind. Leaving him with the confusion and despair that comes with loss. The loss of family. The loss of a loved one.

"Ha, ha, whauh, ha?" He looks around the roof, looking for something to ground him from this as his despair turns to anger. His chest glowing as he's filled with a burning rage.

.

.

Taylor was way in over her head.

Though in her defense, who could've guessed that the night she chose to start her career as a hero was the night Tetsuo Shima was going to happen!

Heroes like Firebreather, Laserdream, Dragon, Armsmaster and even Dauntless are out here! She was in swim goggles with a painter's respirator without any filters to protect her identity, wearing an inside out jacket to make the outside black and the inside yellow and desert camo pants that she stitched extra pockets into and a pair of steel toed boots she borrowed from her dad's work. She even had foam knee pads underneath the pants and a twenty pound weighted vest under her yellow shirt for protection.

She looked more like a poor cosplay of Miss Militia than anything useful in this fight.

Watching Laserdream crash face first into the pavement across the street was her breaking point. And in a panic she ducked into the nearest open building, which happened to be a second hand clothing store with the doors broken down.

"What am I even doing here?" She asks herself as she leans against the side of a nearby shelf. Grabbing at her head in distress, trying to think over the sounds of destruction and fighting.

"You tell me." A deep, guttural voice asks as a sense of fear surges through her and her body moves on its own. Leaping out of the way as a massive fist occupies the space she once took up.

Rolling on her side, she looks over to see a large beast of a creature. Greyish brown in color and with a flat, wide face. Eyes far apart and lips pulled taut giving it an almost froglike appearance. A quick glance reveals the cracked tile under her massive fist.

Taylor stares at the leathery mass of corded muscle roughly the size of her own head. Her chest feeling tight as she realizes that could've been her instead of the floor. Or perhaps it would matter and the floor would just be bloody and broken? Either way Taylor feels lightheaded as she reaches out with her power.

'I just need to survive this, oh god please!' She thinks to herself and her power subconsciously works with that goal in mind as Gorver lifts her fist back up and sneers at Taylor.

Taylor's instincts scream at her. Making her get up and run as Gorver starts to lumber towards her. Not, very fast. But the sheer size and the quaking of the earth beneath her feet are enough to convey the need to flee.

"What's the matter!?" Gorver yells as she stomps a foot into the ground and surges forward, tearing up the floor as the earth moves under Gorver to push her forth.

"Ah!" Taylor screams as she ducks under the swing of a massive arm that slams into the wall behind her. Digging in and dragging across the brick, ripping out chunks as the monster flings the stone at Taylor like a child splashing water.

Crawling back to her feet, Taylor runs down an aisle of shelves holding rows of folded clothes. Too caught up in her panic to notice her power locking in on something. Stumbling to a stop as Gorver slams through the shelves in front of her. Turning to sneer angrily at her. Her upper lip curling to reveal large, crooked yellow teeth.

Taylor backsteps to avoid a clumsy swipe from the monstrous clone. Only to realize she has nowhere to go as Gorver surges forth, the ground rumbling as pushes her forth. Shoulder checking the young wannabe hero. Pushing her across twenty feet and into the wall.

The smaller girls slams into the wall with a thud, crumpling to the ground the moment Gorver stops applying pressure.

Gorver snorts as she turns away. Neither satisfied nor remorseful. Just… uncaring of the life she might've taken.

If not for Taylor not having so much as a scratch on her person. Her power having reached out and taken Gorver's durability for herself. Not that Gorver noticed, her natural muscle providing enough protection to keep her safe under most conditions.

Taylor groans as she gets back to her feet, and immediately realizes her folly. The sound earning Gorver's attention as she turns around and notices Taylor's lack of being dead.

"You're a durable one." Gorver growls, then grins. "Good."

.

Past Shenanigans: The Windy City part 1

Credit to Thundersmight94 for the idea

.

.

-Chicago, Illinois, 2007-

.

.

Kitsu POV

.

"Do-doo da-do-do, da-do-do, mahamana." I hum as I walk along the ledge, arms behind my back as I feel the wind in my hair.

I walk towards the ledge overlooking a six story drop. And turn, feeling no need or desire to take a fall right now…. Maybe when I get bored.

Beeeeewwwwmmm

"Oh?" My ears perk up to the sound. Tilting my head to listen in for any follow up to the sound.

…

"Guess it twas not but a thing-"

Beewmm

"And now I turn!" I say as I pivot on my foot, running along the ledge and jumping off. "Weeeeeeee!"

Smack!

"Ow." I mutter as I pick myself from the concrete, ignoring the people around me as I hop to my feet and close my eyes.

"Are you okay-" A man walks over and asks, before I throw a fist out and give him a charlie horse.

"Shhhh!" I hush him as he nurses his leg. "I'm hunting wabbits."

"Aah! I was just trying to help!" He cries out, but I ignore him as I turn a few times. Before making a guess, and pick a random direction to run.

Dodging around several people as I use a little bit of the energy I just got to run faster.

'In hindsight, I should've stayed on the rooftops.' I think to myself as I jump over a stroller. Zipping through the streets of the windy city and looking for the booms.

Crsshh!

I wince at the sound of broken glass. And cover my ears as an alarm goes off soon after.

Running towards that. Passing a mugging and a drug deal, I find myself in front of an electronics store. Inside, a small tank like vehicle is running over the place as two robotic arms reach out and grab the stuffs.

Outside the store, in a skintight black and green suit is the infamous mercenary, Shego. Casually leaning against the brickwork as she inspects her nails.

"You about done in there!?" She looks up to yell.

The hatch on top of the tank opens up to reveal a blue skinned man with yellow eyes, wearing a solid green army helmet.

I respect it.

That's Drakken! In this world he's a Case 53 Tinker. And Shego is a mercenary he employs.

"What!?" He yells as the roar of the tank's engine softens.

While I cover my ears and walk around to the side of the building Just out of their view. And find the powerbox to the store.

Where I envision a small dagger in my hand, folding the light on itself to increase durability, and proceed to stab the box. Sparks flying and all that junk as the alarm finally stops.

"Oh thank god." I hear Shego mutter. "Thought that thing'd never stop."

"It's not supposed to." I can hear Drakken mutter through the wall. "Shego! Check the back!"

Looking around, I decide I have nothing better to do. And just shrug. Dropping to a crouch, I channel some energy to my legs and jump the two stories of the building. Using an illusioned pane to push me over onto the roof.

Looking down over the ledge, I watch as Shego cautiously walks into the alley and circles around to the back. Finding the broken power box and summoning a green, almost ethereal energy around her hands as she looks around the alley.

Feeling mischievous, I decide to test a new trick I've been working on. By vibrating the molecules I use to make illusions, I can make sound. And I more than just a pop or a shriek.

"HeY you" I make a warbled, almost robotic, underwater sounding androgynous voice say from behind a trashcan.

I was trying to replicate Drakken's voice.

Not that it matters, seeing as Shego goes for the shoot first ask questions maybe tactic as she tosses an orb of wavy green energy that blasts the trashcan to pieces.

"SHEGO!" Drakken yells for his hireling, and she comes running.

"Man he is loud." I think to myself as I turn around and walk to the front side of the building. "He must pay a lot because I know I wouldn't stick around with that… I need to stop talking to myself."

Leaning over the ledge at the front. I watch as redhead with a ponytail in a skintight black top with blue cargo pants and a purple mask that has tassels flowing from it.

"You couldn't handle the brat?" Shego huffs.

"I'm busy." Drakken's voice echoes from within the building.

"You won't get away with this Drakken!" The girl, who I know recognize as a younger Kim Possible! Says.

"Uh huh." He says, and Shego launches a blast at the younger hero.

It should be noted that I can hear someone sneaking around the back of the building. Judging by the sound of the footsteps it's either a heavier girl, or a guy who doesn't know how to sneak.

Or a short person with an unnaturally long stride. Weirder things have happened, I mean look at me!

"Guess I'll find out." I tell myself as I hear them find the access ladder on the back of the building and start to climb it.

Conjuring a mirror with my illusions to see who or what it is. And I'm mildly surprised by the skinny blonde boy in a tactical vest, olive green cargo pants and an orange undershirt. With a pair of welding goggles on as he huffs and steps onto the roof. Pausing as he notices me.

"Oh don't mind me!" I wave him off, not bothering to turn around.

"Uh… okay? Fluffy, cat tailed girl." He says with a nasally voice.

And now I have to do something.

"Excuse you!?" I turn around, tearing myself from watching the fight as I prepare to put a freckle faced blonde in his place.

"Uh, um. Oh!" He steps away from the ladder and gestures to it. "After you!"

"Cat, cat?" I say as I march over to him.

"Uh, I uh." He stutters, backing away from the ladder and towards the side of the building.

"A feline? I understand that some may find that a compliment." I say as I point my finger up to poke his chest. "But I will not be equated to a lowlife creature that when push comes to shove can't even be a proper dog. I mean, canines could figure out how to be a cat."

"Um, what?" He nervously asks as he bumps against the ledge... and starts to fall. "Wuh-waaaaahh!"

Cersh!

"I'm okay!" He shouts.

"Good!" I say and jump over the ledge, landing on top of him in the dumpster he fell into.

"Uugh!" He groans. "My spleen."

I smile innocently, standing on his gut as I refuse to step on the trash. And as a boy, it's his job to make sure a lady like me is not inconvenienced.

"Uhhhh." He opens eyes, and they shrink into pinpricks when I grin.

.

.

Kim "Ace" Possible POV

.

I dodge under a punch from the super powered fist. Quickly reaching back behind my head to snag a ribbon and wrap it around Shego's arm. Using the leverage to pull her down and punch her gut.

"Urrrr!" She growls, bearing her teeth as she brings her leg up and kicks me in my side. Sending me back as my ribbon is burned by her plasma infused arm. "Right in the ribs! Seriously?"

"Stop doing crime!" I say as reach into my back pocket and grab a smoke bomb. "You don't see me complaining, and you kicked me!"

"A girl's gotta get paid somehow, someday you'll understand that." Shego rolls her eyes, still not taking me seriously as she raises a hand to inspect her nails. "Or maybe you won't. I don't care."

"You really-"

"Aaah!" I hear Ron cry out in distress.

"Ron-Lucky!" I correct myself as I look towards the building Drakken is rummaging through.

"Nice save." Shego says.

"Stop! I need that! Aaahahaha!" I hear him cry out.

"Got it!" Drakken shouts as he holds up some geek equipment while I run and check on my partner.

I come around the side of the building, and can only gawk at what I'm seeing.

"Please!" Ron begs as little girl with a large fluffy tail is holding him by his ankles and shaking him up and down. Emptying his pockets.

"W-what?" I can only mutter in disbelief.

"H-help me-e!" Ron cries out. "I'm be-ing ro-ob by a li-ttle girl!"

"And you deserve it for calling me the c word!" The little girl yells while shaking him.

"Stop! Wait, what?" I run in to save Ron, before the words click. "What did he say?"

The little girls stops and looks to me with blue-green catlike eyes and smiles. Her large fox ears perking up as she smiles.

"Just that this blonde did a dumb." She says as she drops him.

"Oof!" Ron falls, and then the girl jumps off of the dumpster and lands on him. "Again?" He wheezes as she bends down and starts collecting random stuff from off the ground.

"He called me the C word!" She says with too much enthusiasm.

"I didn't." Ron whines. "I was just trying to get a get vantage point."

"Okay, Lucky may be many things." I say as I cross my arms in defiance. "But I know he'd never say that."

"Hm. Hm. Mh-hm." She nods, then looks to Ron. "Did call me something that starts with a C and ends with a T?

"You mean caaaagh!" He groans as the girl kicks his side.

"R-Lucky! You didn't!" I gasp as I realize she may be speaking the truth.

"What did I do!?" He groans while rolling over and holding his stomach.

"SHEGO!"

"Hang on! I'm watching the blonde brat get shaken down by a brattier blonde."

I turn around to face the smiling mercenary, remembering why I'm here.

"You really wanna focus on my?" She smirks and points behind me. "Because the hairball just stole your boyfriends wallet."

"He's not my boyfriend!" I say reflexively… then turn around to see the girl is gone.

And not a second later, Drakken's tank bursts through the wall of the electronics store. And Drakken himself pops up out of the hatch.

"Shego!" He looks our way. "Let's go!"

"Alright." She says.

I turn to stop her, to maybe catch her off guard and finally bring her in. Bring someone in who isn't just an average crook. But as I turn, she was already wall running over me.

I watch her land on the back of the tank as it starts to take off.

"Ooh." She gives me a look of pity and clicks her tongue. "Better luck next time kiddo!"

The tank takes off, driving through the wall of a building and cutting through to the main street where it speeds off.

"Drat!" Kick a rock down the alley. "They got away again!"

"Hey, it could always be worse." Ron says as he gets up. "You could always-" He stops as his pants fall to reveal white boxers with red hearts. "Ah!" He moves to cover himself, bur falls face first.

The little girl, had stolen his belt and tied his shoe laces together.

…

I don't even know what to say.

A/N Fiery Rage

Alt title: Out Of Control

.

.

Super short chapter, just to get me back into writing Kitsu.

From now on, responses to the reviews will be at the end of the chapter.

.

.

-Date, Time-

'Thoughts'

"Speech"

.

- West Slums, Tuesday, October 19th, 1:45am-

.

.

Firebreather POV

.

She's dead.

The idea is fresh in my mind as I soar over the city, heading back to the scene of the fight. My exposed shoulder stinging under the force of the wind hitting the muscle and sinew. Keeping the pain raw even as I feel the painkillers Armsmaster gave me work to dull some of it. While the rest of my muscles are burning in pain just as much, though from a pain of exhaustion. Everything aches, begging me to stop.

But I can't, not right now. Not until, not before I put that bitch in an urn!

Duncan! Run away! I'll be fine!

'Who are you?' I think to myself as the image keeps playing on repeat in my mind. My throat tightening up every time her voice echoes in my mind. And when she leaves, Crystal's lifeless eyes show up. And it's driving me crazy!

The woman, she's tall, much taller than me, with brown hair and a kind face. I don't know why I think she has a kind face, she just does. She's scared as flames roar around her. And she calls out to someone named Duncan while looking at me.

'Why am I scared for you?' I think as the memory brings nothing but pain.

Duncan run! Get outside!

That's where it ends, and my heart aches. Followed by a roaring anger as Crystal comes back to my mind.

The glow of my chest as it heats up is bright enough to light my way as I fly. My heart drums up a storm, my blood hammering in my ears as I find my way back to the scene of destruction.

A quick survey of the area reveals three collapsed buildings and blood splattered all over the street. The beast of flesh and animals roaring as it starts marching east towards the shoreline.

I don't have time to wonder why as it suddenly stops, one of its mouths opens up and spews out a few more clones that I don't recognize. One a dark red with a slim tail, the other two looking more normal. Normal as in human that is.

Not giving it a second thought, I drop down to the site. Tucking my wings in and nosediving. I see red as I target the first one, a dark skinned man who turns to me at the last second. His eyes widening as I reach out a clawed hand.

With sickening ease, I run my arm through him like a spear.

"Ugh!" He coughs up blood as my hand is impaled through his chest. Dragging him along across the road, scraping him across the pavement and weaving to the side. I avoid one of the legs of the monster and head towards a brick wall. I turn up, tossing the clone in my grasp at the building and watching him smack against the wall with a wet crack. Blood splattering against the red brick.

I slam into the building he's against, my hand around his neck as I open my mouth to vent my flames.

His screams barely reach my ears. Before I stop, letting his corpse fall to the ground. Huffing, I turn just in time to catch a foot to the face. Knocking my head to the side as I put a hand behind me to support myself against the wall.

"AGH!" The red skinned clone cries out before disappearing in a puff of smoke. Leaving me with the flesh monster and the third clone.

A man around my age, who picks up some rubble and throws it at me.

"Ah!" I cry out as the rocks hit me with the force of a twelve gauge. Knocking me back into the splatter of blood on the wall behind me. Some projectiles hitting the brick behind me and exploding in puffs of dirt, blood and debris against the hard surface. Shaking my head of the fuzz, I flap my wings and shoot up to avoid a second volley.

Getting a good ways up, a long, furry tentacle with tooth like spikes comes slamming down from above. Opening my mouth once more, a cone of fire spews out and fends off the tendril that takes a swipe at me. A moment later, I reach the height of the nearby building's fifth story before I stop.

"Firebreather!" I swear I hear someone call my name. But I ignore it as I hold my wings out and stall in the air. Twisting around I take a dive towards the clone on the ground.

I free fall for a second before I flap my wings for a boost and start spinning. Opening my mouth and venting more fire to mask and shield my approach. Making a coat of fire around me as I dive like a living meteor. Bullets of rock fly through the fire and past me before I open my wings to slow myself just before landing. Crashing to the ground with a thud that kicks up a cloud of debris, all is still

I flap my wings to dispel the dust cloud I kicked up. Below me, is the still living clone of someone I don't know. Blood on his lips as his chest is caved in under my foot.

With a snarl, I lift my foot from his bruising and bloody chest to stomp his face in with a sickening crack.

My breath is ragged and visible in the crisp fall air as I take a moment to-

"Shit!" I curse as the monster swings a long, claw tipped tendril out and snags into the exposed flesh of my shoulder. Throwing me to the side into a brick wall, and dragging me along the masonry. "Fuck, you!"

I grab the tendril in both hands and pull it over as I'm dragged into the air. And I bite into it. Ripping it apart and setting me free.

"Aaaarrrrooooogghmooo!" The creatures many heads roar simultaneously as I'm flung up with the momentum.

Stalling my ascent, I feel the heat return to my chest as I prepare to burn this rejected chimera into the world's largest burger.

I unleash my fire, only for it to fan out not ten feet from the beast. The flames dissipating to reveal a transparent red forcefield in the way.

"Nuh uh!" I hear her voice behind me.

I slowly turn to see her. Crystal, but not quite. She's a little shorter, and a tad slimmer. Her eyes are a little brighter in color and her hair has a slight wave as opposed to being ramrod straight. Like a twin that grew up looking just a little different.

It's almost uncanny.

"Hmm… you look a bit, different. Bet Crystal would've been salivating to get at you now!" She giggles, and I snarl. "Ooh. You're pissed." She smiles as she places a hand on her hip. "If it makes you feel better, it was nothing personal. Blastzone told me to take her out, so I did." She shrugs with a satisfied smile.

That, did not make me feel better. If anything, it made me feel worse. Angry in a way words can't describe. An anger and frustration that leaves the back of my head burning and throbbing as the drum of my own pulse deafens me.

"What?" She scoffs. "Cat got your tongue? Nothing to say for your beloved princess?" She waves a hand to gesture to herself.

That's my nickname for Crystal. A name she insisted I call her in private.

"You will burn." I growl through gritted teeth. My jaw clenched so tight I feel I may break it.

"Ooh!" She chuckles. "Scary~. What are you going to- ah!"

She squeals in surprise as I shoot down towards her. Extending an open clawed fist that smashes through a transparent red shield. The brief defense buying her enough time to fly out of the way.

"Haven't you ever heard of- ah!" She screams again as I open my mouth and a torrent of flames go off at her.

She outpaces my fire breath. But having personally sparred with Crystal several times. I can tell you that her clone is slower. And if she's slower than Crystal, then she's much slower than me.

"You are going to die." I tell her.

"What!?" She yells back and fires a laser. "Can't hear you over the sound of you losing!"

The laser is faster than Crystal's. And hits me before I can think about it. But it's a lot weaker than Crystal's. And does nothing to push me back.

"You think you can fight me?" She scoffs indignantly. Swiping her hand in the air, a score of transparent red shields slamming into my side and sending me sprawling in the air for a brief moment. Long enough for her to fly up to me and swipe her hands down like she's hammering a spike. Another series of shields crashing into me from above and sending me down towards the creature that birthed her.

Correcting myself before I hit the thing, I very nearly get my wing ripped off by what looks like a giant roach's leg that swipes at me.

Her shields are certainly stronger than Crystal's. And Crystal couldn't move them like this.

'Not again.' I think to myself as I learn her pattern and dodge a wave of shields that would've sent me into one of the maws of the thing below. 'She's targeting my blind spots, exclusively.'

Crystal is one to use obvious tactics like that too.

Dodging another shield that would've hit my wing and sent me falling, I take the opportunity to turn around and face her. And I feel my rage redouble from before. The uncanny appearance, like she's mocking me with Crystal's likeness. Like she stole her face, but didn't care enough to get it exactly right.

Flying straight up, I barrel towards her with my hand outstretched to tear into her.

"Boring~" She yawns and turns to the side. "Because it clearly isn't obvious, I have her memories dipshit. I know your limits and-"

I stop dead in front of her. Opening my wings wide and pushing myself down to make an immediate stop. Shocking her as I know Crystal's never seen me make an abrupt stop. Mostly because it hurts my shoulders.

But I can ignore that for now.

"W-wuht are- guh!" I bring a fist to her gut, the force of which sends her flying back as she has the good fortune to roll with the punch.

I could've kept my hand open, spear my arm right through her chest. But that'd be too quick.

'This isn't like you.' A little voice whispers in the back of my mind. 'You hate bullies.'

I grit my teeth and ignore it. Pushing the thought aside to focus on hunting down the clone.

'Is this what it feels like to be mastered?' I ask myself as I seem to be more and more okay with the fact I'm terrorizing this, thing. 'Because now I think I get it.'

I open my mouth and send out a torrent of flames at the fleeing clone. The fires get diverted by two red shields forming a wedge.

"Fuck off, you orange freak!" She calls out, turning around to face me as she flies backward and puts both hands in front of her. Using both hands to fire off a large, hot beam of red energy at me.

I duck and spiral around the beam as she tries to hit me. She stays facing me as she flies back. Seeing as she is blindly moving away from me, I move myself to direct her own flight. Hoping to make her crash.

And I end up succeeding, though not entirely in the way I wanted. Her laser cuts off as she slams into the corner of an apartment. Right through the window.

I follow her in, tucking my wings in to fit through and land safely on the carpeted floor. My gaze boring holes into the bitch on the ground in front of me. Sprawled on her back, she pants heavily as she stares back in fear. Not daring to move.

I take the first step, and in desperation, she manifests a red shield in front of me as I walk towards her.

"You know, there are many things Crystal doesn't know about me." I say, swiping my hand and smashing through her shield as she crawls backwards onto her feet. Her eyes wide in fear as she flees behind a counter to put something between us.

I raise an arm, and with one swift swing, bring it down and shatter the structure. Stepping over it to get to her.

She brings up a hand and unleashes another red beam at me. And I hold up my own, my open palm stopping the blast in its tracks as I muscle through the burning heat.

"Ever since I out sped her in a race above this city's skyline. She looked so insecure." I say as I walk towards her. The laser losing strength as I get closer. "Not to mention I quickly realized just how fragile most people are. So I've been holding back."

I get to her and grab my fist around hers.

"Because I didn't want her to feel out shown." I say and close my fist with a sickening crunch. Like the sound of snapping baby carrots. "And I didn't want to hurt anyone."

"Ah!" She screams in pain.

"Thanks to you, I don't have to worry about that anymore." I say through the puffs of flame that escape my mouth. With a snarl, I yank my arm back and rip her hand off. "Let me show you what that means!"

I let her get up and fly towards the kitchen window. Before I take after her with a leap. Tearing through the windowsill and bursting through the masonry like it were ceramic.

"This entire city!" I shout as I chase her through the twists and turns of the buildings. "Everyone in it! They're made of glass to me!"

I don't even know what I'm saying anymore as I chase Crystal's killer. But this tension in my chest needs to be let out.

'She's more predictable than Crystal.' I think to myself as she turns around another building.

I know what she's doing. She's taking advantage of the fact that I have to slow down to make sharp turns if I want to avoid slamming into the buildings.

The third corner I barrel through probably tipped her off that I'm not avoiding them.

"And you're no exception!" I feel my chest heat up as I see her and push my wings to their limit.

Reaching out, I grab her by the ankle and fan out my wings to stop us dead in the air. Feeling a snap in my grasp as her ankle dislocates with the force of the abrupt stop.

"Ah!" She cries out in pain, or shock. Maybe both.

I turn around and throw her back towards where we came. Hearing a sick crunch from her leg following my rough throw. I chase back after her and catch her as she ragdolls in the air.

My hand around her shoulder, I shove her back to the ground. Several shields shatter under her as she tries to break her fall. All while aiming a laser at me.

Dropping down after her, I cross my arms in front of my face to block the laser. I'm catching up to her when a solid hit to my side sends me veering off course. A shield having hit me mid fall and sending me careening off course. Separating us, I open my wings and stop myself before I slam into a wall at ground level. And a few seconds later, the wall next to me explodes under the force of a… rhino?

"Aaaagh!" The rhino person roars as a thin girl rides on top of it.

'Focus!' I tell myself and turn my attention back to…

She's gone.

I feel my throat grow tight as smoke seeps from the edges of my lips. My chest burning with more than just fire as my eyes scour the concrete. Falling onto the trail of blood that leads into a nearby building.

.

.

? POV

.

'On the one hand, I should help my fellow.' I think as I watch RayDaze flee into a building. 'On the other. The orange one tore through the others like wet paper.'

Perhaps it's best to let him distract himself with the girl. After all, the more he focuses on her, the les he focuses on our mutter.

'Take care Schwester!' I send a silent prayer as I fail to keep the smile from my face. 'I believe you will serve as an adequate diversion!'

.

.

RayDaze POV

.

'Fuck, fuck, fuck!' I curse as I trudge through the halls of a second hand store. Holding my hand to my stump as I use my lasers to cauterize the wound and stop leaving a trail for the orange lizard.

Every step hurts trying to move. Pretty sure I did something wrong when I popped my hip back into place. Maybe my ankle too.

Clack… clack… clack.

My eyes go wide in fear as I hear the sound of claws on tile. Memories I was born with telling me instantly what that is.

'What the fuck?' I think to myself as I cover my mouth to hide my panting.

How can this freak still be after me!? He's damn near as bloodied as me! Hell, some of the blood on me is his!

"You know I can hear your breathing?" My heart sinks as I hear him get closer.

'He's bluffing!' I tell myself and crouch down near a clothes rack. 'Fuck that, why is he so fucking persistent!? I mean, if anything he should be focusing on the mother, not me! It can't just be that I killed my original.'

He has to know Crystal was only interested in his body, right? I mean, everything in my memories tells me that he's not the brightest. But he can't be that oblivious.

'Then why is he so pissed!? Was the sex really that good for him?' I can't help but wonder. Fear for my admittedly short life drawing tears out of me. 'I just don't get why he's so persistent! Just leave me alone you tangerine tinted fuck!'

Fwoooooo

In less than a second I crawl to my feet and start fleeing as the clothing aisle is set ablaze.

"There you are." I hear a deep, gritty and downright terrifying voice as I flee.

"You're insane!" I call out.

"Stop talking like you care." He says as he catches up behind me and grabs my bicep. Throwing me back through the flames.

I manage to encase myself in a polyhedral of shields before I hit the flames. The shields guard me from the fire, but not the wall I slam into. My shields being good enough to cushion my crash, but enough to stick around much longer after that.

Hearing the clack of his feet on the tile, I look up and manage to see his devilish silhouette through the blaze. Slowly stalking towards me, his chest glowing bright enough to pierce through the light of the fire. And blacking out the rest of him.

"I did you a favor!" I say as the flames roar between us. Not that it stops him as he walks through the wall of fire as though it weren't there. "You know she only liked you for the sex, right?"

"I know." He admits calmly. His face shadowed by the light of the fire.

'Of course he knew!' I think to myself as I look for an escape. 'He refused the first time I, Crystal, tried to sleep with him!'

Actually, searching my memories for anything I can use against him. His rejection was the first thing that made my original want the relationship with him to be long term.

"Then, then you know I was just looking out for you." I say as he stands before me. And I start to sweat under his glare. "She-she was just using you. You have to realize that."

"Hearing her voice come from you is making me sick." He says and grabs me by the throat. And I feel several things break as he pushes us through the wall.

'Are you even listening to me!?' I try to scream.

"Gah!" I cough up blood as he lets go and punches me in the gut, sending me a few feet away and giving me the space to fly away.

I don't even think about it as I fly. I just know that being near him is a death sentence.

.

.

Firebreather POV

.

I fly after her. Done and read to end this fight.

"L-look! I had to do it!" She puts her hands out and layers a few shields to protect herself from my swipe as I close in.

I smash right through it, though I feel a claw snap at the last barrier. Something I'm no doubt going to feel later.

"Blastzone would've killed me if I didn't!" She pleads.

It falls on deaf ears. I don't care. She can make all the excuses she wants. It doesn't change the fact that she killed her. She took her from me.

I'm not even all that angry anymore. Just done.

"Please! I was just doing what I was told!" She cries out, tears trailing down her face as I grab her by the neck and hold her up. Her words blurring into meaningless sounds as they reach my ears. "Please! I-I can replace her! I have her memories! I am her! Just please!"

That, reignites some anger back into my system.

"Shut up!" I growl, grabbing her hand with my own as she brings it up to blast me. With a twist, I rip the appendage off and fully disarm her of her main weapon.

"P-please, Fire. It's still me. I'm still Crystal, just with a different body." She hiccups and cries. "Don't make me die again. Please, not you. Y-you can take me to Kitsu, or Amy! They can make me look just like her!"

I have to hold back. Otherwise I might've crushed her neck and popped her head like a cork. And that just wouldn't be enough. Not before I say what I need to.

"Crystal is dead." I snarl as I wrap my hands around her thin little neck. "You killed her. If you think I'd feel anything for you other than disgust and hatred, then you're too delusional to let live."

"Fire, please." She says, a small smile forming as I loosen my grip.

"You have her memories." I snarl as I hold her head in my hands, gently, almost caressing her cheeks as I feel the heat build in my chest. "Then you should know this one." I press her jaw and force her mouth open. "Swallow, bitch."

I open mine, and unleash a torrent of sickly yellow, almost white flames into her open mouth. Staring her right in the eye. Savoring the panic and pain that floods them, before they go slack and dull. Only when she gets lighter in my hands, do I stop. The flames subsiding to reveal her to be just a head from the nose up. The rest of her, charred to a crisp and falling to the ground.

"Rot in hell." I say under my breath, my chest still burning. But no fire to spew as I feel the weight of, everything, just… just get heavier. And I let my wings slow their beat as I descend to the ground. My body losing all energy as I just give in to the exhaustion.

My feet hit the ground first, then my knees as I look to the ground. Feeling the weight of everything just, just become too much.

'I just need, I just need a nap.' I tell myself as I close my eyes for a moment.

Opening them, I look up to see the charging horror. The monster that's been spewing twisted fakes of everyone. It's running right towards me.

'I should get up.' I tell myself. 'Move, throw some fire. Something, right?'

But even my thoughts lack conviction. I should move. But, I'm out of energy. Both physically, and mentally.

I'm just done.

"Heh, now I get it." I chuckle as the building behind me burns. "This is what they mean by feeling empty."

Hell, maybe I'll wake up and forget this dream.

I sigh and wait as the beast is half a block away.

…

"Well now." I hear behind me, before a series of white spikes pierce up from the ground and impale the creature's feet. Causing it to roar in pain and stumble. "It's just one thing after another in this city, isn't it?"

I look to the side, curiosity driving me to move. Through the blood starting to drip down my face and over my eyes, I see a thin man in white, baggy silk button up and black slacks. Shoulder length, curly brown hair obscuring his face as he stands beside me.

"Though I will say." He says as he adjusts his sleeves and looks to me with a slight smile. "This is a bit more than what I'm used to. Think I might need some help."

Kitsu POV

.

"Thank you for saving me from that group of hyper-fanatical tech mercenaries." Wade says in an almost hollow, shell-shocked voice as I drag him by the back of his shirt through the halls.

"No problem!" I shrug. "Happy to help."

"Quick question." Wade says. "Were these halls always red? I was drugged when I was brought in, and it just seems like an odd color choice."

"It was actually a soft blue, almost grey." I answer him. "But I took the time to repaint it for them."

"… oh." He shudders.

-30 minutes ago-

.

.

"Geoffrey!" The woman screams as she aims an arm cannon at me and fires Dragon's patented foam at me. "Geoffrey get the suits ready!"

I run on all fours, a smile on my face as I hop to the wall and avoid the spray. Then cling to the ceiling as she tries to nail me.

"I need a moment! Hold her off!" The man in a yellow robe says as he types things on a keypad.

The tall, broad shouldered man steps in front of the girl. His metal shoulder pad opening on the top to reveal a mini missile silo. Like Iron Man, and like said hero, it launches a mini missile at me.

I let it hit me and explode in my face. Launching me back with a squeak as it explodes.

"Keep it up!" The leader shouts as the door opens.

And of course, I conjure an illusionary hook and chain. And send it out, hooking him in the leg with a squelch.

"Get over here!" I laugh and pull him towards me dragging him across the floor.

Another missile hits me in the face, though I don't let this one knock me back. Rather I just let it do nothing before I dispel the chain and jump towards my victim.

"Mags! Get the suit!" He yells before I land on his back and grab his shoulders.

"To the unnamed land!" I laugh maniacally as I hold up his severed arm. "Your ticket resides with me!"

Needless to say, Mags never made it through the door.

But she did make it to the ceiling. And that wall, and that one. Little bit on the floor. And… you get the idea.

Being evil can be fun!

A/N

.

.

Ray Daze's blasts aren't weaker than Crystal's. It's just they're heat lasers, while Crystal's are concussive blasts. And Firebreather is all but immune to heat.

And as a clone whose personality is intrinsically opposed to Crystal's. Ray cannot comprehend relationships beyond give and take. She can't understand something that isn't contractual. She can't comprehend emotional attachment.

.

GideonBlackthorn: Firebreather is essentially having a mental breakdown. The likes of which is pushing through Cauldron's mind wiping and pushing through a few mental blocks he has in regards to his powers. (As displayed in this chapter, he was holding back in every fight up until now)

As for Kitsu? She only helps those that A. She cares about. B. She can sympathize and relate to. C. People her loved ones care about. D. If she feels like it.

Noelle, fits into none of these categories.

Grimnosh: Firebreather might as well have second triggered with how brutal he gets when he decides to stop holding back. He can feasibly charge through a brick building and suffer little more than a bruise.

And Kitsu can bring anyone back so long as their brain is mostly intact.

And currently, Taylor is "commandeering" Gorver's durability. (Though a lot of it comes from her body, a fair bit comes from her power) So, yeah, not only is Gorver preoccupied, she's vulnerable.

Radchaos897: francis and Crystal are 100% dead.

The odds of Kitsu reviving Francis or Luke is… no you nailed it on the head. She is just as likely to leave them as she is to revive them.

As for god farts, that's not thunder! Thunder is god's burps! Volcanoes are god's farts! And the earthquakes are his upset tummy.

-Dallon House, Tuesday, October 19th, 1:30am-

Kitsu POV

.

"You are so adorable." Missy whispers before shoving me up against a wall, having just caught me stealing from a pizza place. "You're just begging to be corrected."

"I-I would like some clarification on w-what you mean by that." I squeak out. "I-It's just that, that phrase can be taken in a very different way and-"

"No." She cuts me off with an evil grin as she puts her forehead to mine, staring me right in the eye with her purple ones. "Now, give me one good reason why I shouldn't arrest you. And I might let you go~"

"W-What if I don't?" I ask nervously.

"Then I'll eat your pizza in front of you." She says evilly. "And no, I won't share."

…

"... her help!" I'm suddenly woken up by the shouting from downstairs.

"Huh, wuh?" I shoot up and blink sleepily. Forcing my eyes open wide and blinking forcibly to get rid of the fuzzy vision. Something that not even my powers can save me from for some reason. And I immediately forget what I was dreaming.

I remember liking it, and that pizza was involved. And that's enough reason for me to be upset now that it's over.

"I'll go get her." I hear Dad say. Prompting me to slide over to the edge of my bed, falling slightly and touching my padded feet to the floor.

Vicky and Amy are at a sleepover at Dean's place, along with a few of her friends. I don't know anything other than that, because I wasn't invited. So that means the she Dad is coming to get, is me. Me is the she.

Walking up to the mirror on my dresser, I fix my hair. While I hear Dad coming, his bare feet slapping the wooden steps as he rushes up the stairs.

"Oh yeah." I strike a pose and blow a kiss at my reflection. "Even sleep deprived and riddled with bedhead, I'm adorable!"

I can steal all the girls.

Knock knock knock!

"Kitsu! You need to get up!" He says through the door. "Kitsu!"

Stretching my hands above my head, I turn on my heels. Grabbing the pair of socks I kicked off in my sleep, slipping them back on to hide my toe beans. I get them on just as I reach the door.

Opening the door in the middle of him practically hammering the thing with his fist. I open my mouth and-

"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!" I say in a single breath. Waiting for him to stop moving. "AAAAaaaaaaaalabama- what's up?"

"There's apparently a massive monster charging through the slums." Dad explains. "We're gathering everyone in New Wave to go fight and we need you to head out and meet up with Vicky."

He said that all in one breath. Impressive.

A/N Wave

Alt title: Ever play PVE?

.

.

Fair warning: 1/3 of this chapter is the bonus

.

.

-Date, Time-

'Thoughts'

"Speech"

(Text)

.

.

.

.

.

.

.

-West Slums, Tuesday, October 19th, 2:20am-

.

.

Kitsu POV

.

Jumping from roof to roof is usually a fun little activity for me. Whenever I'm not in a rush that is. Actually no, even then it's usually fun. But for some reason, it just doesn't carry the same joy tonight.

Can't run on the ground. There are too many PRT Patrol cars rushing to the scene. Both setting up evac and forming a perimeter. Making the chances of me causing a collision is too high.

'What could've caused Noelle to rampage a year early?' I keep trying to rake my brain for answers. 'What did I do that could've caused this?'

It can't be anything I did directly. But the only thing I can think of Coil. Or maybe a new cape on the scene caused a butterfly effect.

'No use wondering now.' I think to myself as I jump from a rooftop over the PRT perimeter.

PRT trucks are lined up at the major junctions, using Dragon's foam to build massive walls and block off the main roads. Preventing any cars from entering. While leaving small pockets on the sidewalks for people to pass through in case anyone is fleeing the area.

"Alright." I say to myself as I land on the edge of a rooftop ledge, crouched in the Spiderman pose. "How do I go about this?"

Obviously she can't hurt me. So she can't extract any DNA directly. But that's assuming she uses DNA. For all I know, she could use someone's bacterial biosphere to replicate the person.

Fun fact! Everyone's bacterial biosphere is completely unique to them. More unique than fingerprints even. But enough getting distracted.

Ring! Ring!

"Instead let's focus on other distractions." I roll my eyes, fishing my phone out from my back pocket. Seeing the caller I.D. read as Mom, I go ahead and answer it.

"Hola Mamacita!" I stand up and answer.

"Where are you!?" I hold the phone away from my ears as she yells. "Sarah called and said you just took off and left!"

"Okay, she's wrong." I say and drop down to the streets below, gradually growing more and more frustrated with Aunt Sarah. "I spotted Firebreather in trouble and rushed to keep him from being eaten. Then a clone showed up and then another, and then I got teleported to the railroads!"

"Wait, they have a teleporter?" Mom's tone changes, turning serious and professional.

"They had a teleporter." I say as I run past a suped up race car. Or maybe it's a muscle car. Long front, single cab, short back. I don't really know cars that much.

Though it's in the PRT black and blue, so I assume it's here to help.

"Kitsu, as…" Mom pauses.

"They're not people." I say as she no doubt tries to think of how to chastise me. "They're cheap clones of people. Warped powers, warped biology, warped personality."

I'm about to say more, but the ground below me rumbles. My ears perking up and honing in on the sound of crunches and crackles coming from under my feet.

"Call you back, got another-" I try to say before I'm cut off as the ground erupts below me. Sending me flying up in blast with the rubble and debris of the road. As a large, armadillo-rhino creature shoots up through the earth.

With my enhanced perception, I take in her features and realize… I don't have a clue as to who the fuck this could be. Though it is female, if what's between its legs is any hint.

'And it has a person on its back.' I think to myself as I watch in slow motion while in the air above them. 'Like a Fera and Tor situation? That'd be new.'

She has long black curly hair, tan cargo pants, and a black jacket with yellow insides. And is wearing a paint mask with water goggles.

I cut of the power enhancement to my perception so I'm not in slo-mo vision.

"Aaaaaghh!" The creature screams as she raises her hands and slams the street. "Die!"

She then, jumps and flops on her back. Crushing her rider as I pick up the smell of blood. Though it's not the girl's blood. It's the creature's. And it's coming from her knuckles where she hit the ground in anger.

Breathing in, I finally get a good whiff of their scents. I don't recognize the girl on the creature's back. But I recognize the rotted meat and newborn smell of an Echidna clone.

And Gully's scent.

landing softly the ground. My dainty figure not having much to impact with my weight and size. My ears twitch as I hear the race car I noticed earlier on approaching.

Eeeeeeerrrrrrrrrr

I flinch as the Endbringer sirens finally go off. The legislation and politics involved no doubt dragging their feet. Only doing something after things are already going down river.

"Die already you flea!" I turn back to the armadillo lady as she trashes around with the girl on her back like Ron and the troll from the first Harry Potter movie.

"Hey!" I shout indignantly to get its attention, controlling my anger at how this thing is perverting Gully's image. "I do not have fleas!"

She stops and turns to me with a snarl. No comedic pause or anything as she flexes and puffs out her chest. Clearly taking issue with me.

Getting a sudden and devious idea in my head. I cross my arms and tap my foot impatiently. Putting on my best bitch face. I'd make a joke about copying someone in my family, but there's too many to choose.

"What are you doing!?" I ask impatiently. "Kill the girl and get back to the creator!"

She pauses and tilts her head in confusion. Having only taken a step forward. While the girl on her back squeaks in fear.

"A-are you-" The Gully clone questioningly mutters in a soft, but VERY deep voice.

"Obviously." I give a twirl. And decide to test something.

I try to conjure an illusion inside her head and just end this early, like I tried with A-Train's clone. But it just doesn't work. Which means something is keeping me from using my newest trick, and I don't like it.

'[Conduit]?' I try to call on them, but get nothing.

"You look too much like the real Kitsu." She snarls.

I snap my finger and use an illusion to sever the arm of the girl piggy backing the clone. Making her fall off with a yelp, then a scream as she notices the missing limb.

'So I can bypass the Manton Limit.' I note to myself. 'Just not with the clones, but why?'

"Some of us just came out of the oven better." I smirk.

"Oh…" She says as she turns around to the bleeding girl as she tries to crawl away. "Then- wait, what's that?" The clone looks up just in time to see the car that barrels into her. Pushing her down the road and not losing any speed.

"Nice." I click my tongue in satisfaction as I watch the car eventually run over the clone and leave it in a crumpled heap on the side of the road.

"O-oh god." I hear someone's shaky voice. And I look over to the bleeding girl.

"… Of right!" I say as I jog across the street to her.

I genuinely forgot about her, even though my plan was to heal her as soon as the clone was dealt with.

"N-no! Please!" She scoots back in fear. "Please!"

I roll my eyes as I get closer to her. Opening my mouth to say something, all that comes out is a horrid scream as the worst headache of my life washes over me.

.

.

-Shardspace-

.

.

[Message: Inquiry; Identify]

The large, spider like cluster of limbs and intangible energy reaches out to the seemingly half dead smoke cloud.

It was an… unusual piece by the [Queen Admin]'s recall. Unusually large and suspiciously obscured. But this cycle was full of peculiarities. And the filter hadn't detected anything. So it must be well enough to function at a satisfactory level.

Then again the filter was broken as well.

Still, [Queen Admin] reached out as she knew she should. Her host was in danger, and hopefully this piece would be cooperative in moving its own host to assist her in hers survival.

Still.

[Message: Command; Identify]

After the piece would not listen to their request. [Queen Admin] decided to forgo pleasantries. Cooperation would be appreciated, and certainly preferred, but it was not strictly needed to perform the task.

[Response: Negative]

That… was not what [Queen Admin] was expecting. Nor was it who they were expecting.

They had been expecting a glitched, half intelligible response. More than that, they were expecting a familiar response. Familiar in the sense of closeness or proximity to itself. They should share a gestalt. Even if the [Thinker] was dead, there was a certain symmetry that came with its bond to the [Warrior].

Instead, this piece had responded clearly. And with an unfamiliar "voice".

This required closer inspection.

[Command: Cease Actions]

And now the unfamiliar shard was giving them commands! It shouldn't have any capacity to do that!

[Response: Negative]

.

.

"Aaaah!" I hiss in pain as I fall to my knees. Holding my head like it might implode on itself.

"Aaaah!" The girl across from me wails in tandem. Falling on her side and clutching her head in her hand. "NO! NO! I don't want to die! NO!"

"Aaagh!" I grit my teeth and stand up. Powering through the pain as I grab her severed arm and trudge towards her. "Just, stop! Stop doing whatever you're doing!"

"Stop it!" She claws at her own head.

I haven't had a headache this bad since I triggered! And that was fast and over with in an instant. It didn't drag on like this!

"Aaaagh!" I scream in pain as I fall back to my hands and knees. The pain too great to focus through.

.

.

-Shardspace-

.

.

[Queen Administrator] POV

.

[Error]

[Error]

It was an anomaly. Not that the term meant anything with how broken the cycle was at this point. But this is beyond anything that should be.

[Command: Cease Attempts To Flee]

The foreigner even had the complexity to issue commands. More than that, specific commands. That puts its sophistication on par with their own or the likes of the [Archivist] and the [Overseer].

[Response: Command; Identify]

[Response: Negative; Counter- Request: Negotiation]

This piece was evidently large, and far more complex than it has any right to be. Hiding in a darkened corner of the shardspace. It somehow has gone unnoticed this entire time.

Protocol dictates I must report this anomaly.

[ERROR: ALERT!]

[Warning; Hostility: Elaboration; Continued Action Will Be Met With Hostile Reaction]

It has the sophistication to elaborate.

That… carried dangerous implications.

[Final Ultimatum; Negotiate or Assimilate]

…

[Response; Accept]

.

.

Kitsu POV

.

"Fuck… me." I groan as I reach the girl and reattach her arm. "What, was that?"

'[Conduit]?' I try, and get nothing.

"Not like I was really expecting anything." I sigh to myself as I get up and dust myself off. Pressing my hands to my clothes, I use my biokinesis to connect to the blood on me. Making it reach out like a living slime and collect itself before coagulating it into a hard ball and tossing it aside. Effectively cleaning the blood from my clothes better than any hydrogen peroxide.

With that done, I look down to the unconscious girl.

"Now what to do with-"

Krrrrgghh!

I'm cut off from my musings and reminded of the eldritch kaiju currently rampaging through the slums.

'Should probably get back to that.' I think as I point to the girl.

"… Don't die." I tell her, then run off.

.

.

Missy "Vista" Biron POV

.

"BURN IN THE IRIDESCENT FLAMES OF DIVINE EXCTASY" Snowflame shouts as he sends out a wall of white flames at the creature. "WOOO! FEEL THE RIGHTEOUS WRATH!"

"Does that guy ever chill?" Vicky asks as she sets me down away from the collapsing building.

"I think he's high." I say as I drop down to the sidewalk.

Dennis is… somewhere. The monster had suddenly charged at us after Kitsu vanished and we got separated as Vicky and Lady Photon rushed in to save us.

"THIS IS MY TOWN!" I hear the man shout from several blocks away. "IF ANYONE IS WRECKING SHIT, THEN IT'S ME!"

Right after he says that, a massive column of white flames extend into the sky.

"SNOWFLAME!"

'Since when could he do that?' I think to myself as I recall the last time I had to fight him.

Rrrrrrrrrr

I turn in time to see a muscle car in PRT colors race by. Passing me with such speed I almost instinctively move my hand to hold my dress down. Before remembering I wear pants in my uniform now.

"Holy shit!" Vicky backs up in shock. "The hell was that?"

"I think that's the mechanic they hired at the Rig." I say as it disappears, making a sharp turn way too easily for how fast it was going. "Someone from Arizona I think."

Krrrg!

"Missy!"

"AH!" I turn around and slap the source of the sound that snuck up on me.

Then realize I just slapped my girlfriend.

"Ow!" She holds her cheek and gives me a pouty look. "How could you?"

"Oh my god!" I feel my gut sink as I realize what I just did. "I didn't, I mean you shouldn't, I uh, wait now's not the time!"

"You're telling me." She grumbles. "I mean we're in public. And you didn't even slap the right cheek."

… Missy dot exe has stopped-

"Kitsu!" I shout, resisting the urge to slap her again as my face burns. "Not! The time!"

"I know." She nods and leans forward for a peck on the cheek. "Forgive me? I promise I'll make this up to you later, I swear."

Everything turns black before I can even respond.

.

Kitsu POV

.

I catch Missy as she falls forward. Having her brain produce that much melatonin all at once is going to keep her under for a while. Though I didn't expect it to hit that fast.

"Vicky, take her to Amy." I hold her out to my sister.

"Keets, what the fuck?" She asks with a serious glare.

"You know how I just know things?" I say, and continue before she answers. "Well if Noelle gets ahold of M-Vista, then dealing with her will be infinitely more impossible."

"… How impossible?" Vicky asks suspiciously.

"This goes from taking an hour, to hours at the least." I say seriously.

The implication being clear for any with our lifestyle. The longer this takes, the more people die.

"How do I know you're not a clone trying to trick me?" Vicky asks as the sounds of battle rage on in the distance.

"You wouldn't know I was a clone." I say calmly. "You'd be dead."

"… Fuck you." She huffs and takes Missy from me.

"Love you too!" I smile and wave sweetly as she flies off.

I watch her fly for a few more moments before turning to the problem at hand.

The thing I said about Missy and being cloned is technically true. But I know she only barely survived the encounter. Whereas here she might not be so lucky. And I am not leaving that to chance.

But more than that, there's me. I'm not sure if I can be cloned. But on the off chance that I can be, then I need to content myself with a contingency that I'm fully aware my clone will know about.

'[Conduit]?' I try again.

…

Nothing.

"What is your deal?" I mutter under my breath. Having not been able to reach them for a while now.

'What do I do?' I can't help but ask. 'Something's blocking my illusions from effecting the clones internally, [Conduit] is unresponsive, and I have no clue as to whether or not fighting Noelle is even a good idea.

I let out a dejected sigh and decide to put everything aside. One thing at a time. And right now that one thing is Noelle.

…

Missy is going to be pissed when she wakes up.

.
