Running into the fray, I pass the red suited cocaine man in the middle of the street as he holds a little baggy to his face. No doubt juicing up on his supply.

"OH BLESSED BE ME!" He shouts as he tosses the empty bag to the side and runs a hand through his starch white hair. "BY THE POWER VESTED IN MY BODY BY THE GREAT-"

Aaaaand I ignore the rest as I dodge a tentacle that swipes at me.

"Not today Japan!" I say as I dodge another. Turning invisible as I jump and leave a decoy to run in the opposite direction.

They slide under another and I weave around a leg. Feeling my connection to the decoy shatter, I return to the visible spectrum as I tag the leg. And funnel as much energy into my hand's temperature as I can. As fast as I can. Pulling on the bits of Burnscar's power that [Conduit] managed to transcribe into my own. Making this more energy efficient.

Bloody chunks spray out in a red mist as the air and flesh boil and rapidly expand under the near instant heat exchange.

Not a second later and I'm a blur of movement as I avoid the splash zone. Running towards a brick wall I jump and turn to face the direction I was running from. Letting myself fly and land on the wall, striking my hand out into the brick. Anchoring myself while Noelle loses her balance and falls into a building. A series of three foot tall bone spikes shooting up out of her remaining legs. Impaling her in place.

Not a moment later and Firebreather dives down to deliver a cone of blaze on her. While Snowflame sends a wave of white hot flames. Effectively cornering the flesh monster in a fiery cage.

"Why am I here?" I can't help but ask as Noelle wails in pain.

I watch as a limb lashes out from under the coat of fire and slams into Snowflame. Sending him spinning like a ninja star and flying towards me.

I bound up the wall to avoid the addict. I normally wouldn't care, him hitting me is free energy. But skin on skin contact with him gives others a coke high. And I do not need to be dealing with that right now.

His body crashes into the wall right where I was with a crack as he goes through it.

Turning around, digging my feet into the wall above me as I hang upside down and peek into the hole. I focus my ears on the man in santa colors.

…

"Are you dead?" I say.

Bump. His heart pumps. And he raises a hand, giving a thumbs up.

"Never mind." I sigh and look up towards the fight as Noelle breaks free from the bone stakes. Her legs reconfiguring with audible cracks and squelches that make me gag. Now standing stable on five legs. Noelle's body starts churning, her flesh roiling while Firebreather retreats back to a safe distance.

Soon, two of her mouths open, her body retching out a swarm of clones. Some half formed and shambling like zombies, others perfectly formed and charging out in various directions. Letting out their war cries as they grab various bits of rubble and set out on a warpath. and I… I let out a sigh of relief.

"Now this, I can work with." I say as I drop down and charge at the swarm.

I can't get too close to Noelle for fear of her copying me. But I can put a stop to her clones and give everyone else breathing room to deal with her.

.

.

John "The Marquis" Lavere POV

.

'Well this is an issue.' I think as I smirk in a way that can only be described as self deprecating. Sighing as the angry mob of naked people charge at me.

Seems it's forgone its previous strategy in favor of quantity over quality. Vomiting up a veritable army of naked clones that roar in unison.

"This is… disturbing." I grimace as I feel the sharp pain of my bones growing over my skin. Forming a basic set of armor to protect me as I anchor myself in place with bone plates that pierce into the concrete.

One may see it as removing my mobility. I see it as protection against being trampled to death.

Honestly though? I much prefer smaller confrontations. When it came to groups, I always had subordinates like Scarecrow and Tremor to deal with the common folk.

But having a preference, doesn't mean an incapability.

I extend two serrated claws from each hand and roll my shoulders as I prepare for the wave.

VRrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr

A second later and the PRT muscle car barrels through line of the clones. Their bodies proving no deterrent as the car drifts and purposefully spins out. Taking an entire column of the monster's soldiers as it goes.

Any help is welcome.

"Ahahahahaha!"

'I know that voice.' I think to myself as I feel the spot where I was stabbed a few weeks ago flare up in pain. The voice bringing the memory to the forefront of my mind.

The little girl comes barreling in from down the street. Leaping high above the crowd and diving in like a meteor that shakes the ground, fire exploding out from her and all.

"I don't recall that in the dossier I received." I say to myself as I recall what I received from my contact in the PRT.

Which only means that her true capabilities are classified.

"… Hmm." I hum in contemplation as the little girl practically makes a game of this. "Seems I'm not needed here."

I detach from the bone plates keeping me anchored and turn on my heels. Leaving the two heroes to their fun.

Kitsu POV

.

"Batter up!" I laugh as I swing the conjured pink baseball bat at a man. My bat swinging right through him, so fast that his upper body keeps moving forward even as his lower body collapses.

Jumping up, I concentrate energy into my feet to enhance the temperature as I stomp down with both feet. Causing an explosion that blasts the clones away.

"Oh I missed this!" I giggle while charging forward. Swinging my foot forward with enough force to disintegrate the crotch of whoever I hit. Boy, girl, I'm not paying attention.

"HAAAA!" They wail in a high pitched voice as they collapse.

Leaping forward, I grab a person and use my biokinesis to modify them. Transforming the majority of their cells to be cellulose containing. Killing them as I make nitrogen producing bacteria flood their biosphere. Tossing them away, I watch as the chain reaction pays off.

Nitrocellulose. Highly combustible and unstable.

Boom!

And fun to watch!

"I can turn people into bombs!" I roar and turn to another clone, who tries to run, but only gets a few feet away before I grab them and do the same. Only this time I let them explode next to me as I absorb the energy. "Fear me and my wrath! Ahahahaha!"

Running to another lanky looking guy, I grab him by the wrist and swing him in an arc to hit a bunch of clones. He doesn't survive the fifth hit, so I use my biokinesis and reshape his bones and cartilage, making him into another type of bomb as I throw him into a crowd.

Pop!

Spikes fly out and impale more clones.

.

Collin "Armsmaster" Wallis POV

.

"She's not taking this seriously." I relay as I observe the situation from atop an untouched building across the street.

The monster, who's in truth a person by the name of Noelle, allegedly. Had switched tactics after Firebreather, Snowflame and a man matching the description of The Marquis had teamed up to contain it.

Rather than spawning clones of capes with powers. It has resorted to spawning hordes of regular people. Sending a wave of meat shields at its attackers.

That was around the time when Overdrive showed up and started barreling through the clones. Soon after, Kitsu jumped in and began eviscerating the clones alongside him.

'And they wonder why I consider her a high priority threat.' I can't help but ruminate bitterly.

"That's probably a good thing." Dragon says over the comms. "If she eliminates the clones too quickly, then Noelle might change her tactics. This way we have a predictable course of action to work off of."

A generous way of looking at the situation.

"Either way, we have two capes dealing with the clones." Miss Militia says. "We can focus our efforts on the main threat."

"I'll be returning shortly." Dragon says. "What's our head count?"

"Dauntless, Armsmaster, Velocity, Glory Girl, Lady Photon, Brandish, Jenny, Flashbang, Manpower, Shielder, Shadow Stalker, Clockblocker, Racer, myself, Gallant and Kitsu." Miss Militia lists off. "Assault's en route with Lyra and her dogs. Ben, Kid Win and Aegis are not responding to any attempts to reach them. Vista is currently incapacitated, Laserdeam, Gully, Nightcrawler, Pinky and A-Train are MIA."

Bamf!

I turn around to face the sound. Only to be met with the black eyes and wide, sharp toothed grin of a purple skinned preteen girl with yellow tiger stripes on her. Messy pink hair atop her head and two sharp black horns protruding from beneath.

"Morning!" She says with a jovial tone and warm grin.

Er! My early warning system goes off.

But it's too late as she swipes her hands in front of me. A clear, viscous liquid splashing all over me. Causing me to cry out in pain as my exposed jaw burns. My armor sparks and a thick smoke billows out from the damaged circuits.

"Wow!" She giggles as I back away in shock. Panic racing through my mind as I try to think of what to do. "I would've thought you'd at least make your armor somewhat acid resistant."

"Collin? Collin!" Dragon's voice breaks over the intercoms as my visor melts away.

"Blue eyes?" The girl say, her yellow eyes glimmering in the dark now that she's no longer lit up by my HUD's night vison. "My money was on brown."

I feel my jaw burn, but I ignore it in favor of the threat before. Raising my halberd in preparation to fight the… naked teen.

'If I make it out of this.' I think with a deep breath. 'I pray to god this does not find its way to PHO.'

.

.

A/N Character Trope, The Evil Foil

Alt title: Which One's Evil Again?

.

.

Grimnosh: In your last review, I was referring to Rascal's father, not Rachel's. Rascal is Rachel's son, and Rachel doesn't know who the father is. And Rachel/Lyra is unmarried.

RadChaos897: Someone on QQ said it best, Everyone is dealing with an apocalypse while Kitsu is living a Slice of Life. Shout out to you Kirumi!

As for Crystal? She snapped her neck, that was it. Rachel/Lyra was frozen for several hours after bleeding out. And she still managed to bring her back, with some issue that Amy had to fix mind you. But the point still stands.

So as for Kitsu's clone, they share [Conduit]. It was described in the books that the clones get powers by way of Echidna making a replica of their Corona Gemma. Which is a door to the shard they're connected to. It's said to be similar to the budding process by which relatives share a shard. [Conduit] is just lucky that [Transcriptor] (Noelle's shard) is half dead and running on autopilot. Otherwise it might've alerted others to [Conduit]'s existence. [Queen Administrator] didn't do so and is a different story, because like [Conduit, QA is very attached to their host. And doesn't want to jeopardize their host. And again, [Conduit] would not allow any access to Negentropy. The whole point behind why Kitsu needs to absorb power is to avoid using it until a solution to Scion is found. Even though [Conduit] is… notably more advanced than most shards, they're still nothing compared to an entity.

Unrelated note, while I haven't seen Wandavision, I've read the comics and know what her powers can do when she loses touch with reality.

Nice joke on my impostor syndrome.

Mangouschase: Kitsu is a true functioning sociopath, in that she feels no empathy for others or the effects she has on them outside of how they affect her. She does have emotional attachments, she can love, but it's shallower and more possessive than what we would consider.

An Evil Kitsu, is a Psychopath. Less impulsive, less risk taking. Less empathetic, less ability to connect with others. Far, far more manipulative. A sociopath only cares for themselves and maybe a few others with a bear complete disregard for anyone or anything else. A psychopath, only cares for themselves and any feelings they have for others is surface level.

Remember, Kitsu isn't good because she wants to help people. She just likes attention, and doesn't want to overly upset the handful of people she likes.

A/N

Kitsu was setting herself on fire while biokinetically tearing Echidna apart. So Melody, Kitsu's clone, is only partially a copy. A lot of her makeup is actually filled in with a mix of other DNA. Think Jurassic Park and how the Dinos are only like, 70% dino, and 30% frog. Or something like that.

That's why despite being an Echidna clone, Melody doesn't have a desire to destroy everything Kitsu loves. Because she's an imperfect clone that amplifies the worst of her qualities, but didn't manage to inverse her emotional attachments. Melody is actually rather uncaring of Kitsu and her family.

Melody, is just Kitsu if the Dallons never took her in and gave her a reason to be good.

Or so I'd like to say. I'm still undecided.

.

Miss Militia 100% knew Crystal died. But she also knows Kitsu can bring the dead back so long as enough of their brain stays in tact, and was banking on the idea that Kitsu wouldn't let Crystal stay dead.

.

.

For anyone wondering how Kitsu killed the creature. She infected it with an adaptable cancer cell that released a hormone forcing all cells around it to start producing Vitamin A.

With no stop function.

Eventually the creature started stripping itself of flesh to survive, which is how Noelle became separated from it.

.

QUESTIONS!

FOR NEWB!

GUEST: If you had to pick a non anime/game song to be Kitsu's theme, what would it be?

NEWB: For Kitsu, it's Looking At Me by Sabrina Carpenter, Nightcore version. Fast paced and it accurately describes Kitsu's self confidence and desire for attention. As well as her cocky/mischievous attitude. Because whatever it is, be it a fight, a game, or even just an outing, Kitsu has a habit of making herself the center of attention.

GUEST: And what about Kitsu x Missy's theme?

NEWB: Inferno by Bella Poarch and Sub Urban.

It's actually rather perfect. Because Missy is aware and recognizes the fact that Kitsu is not a good person. But even still, Missy can't help but be drawn to Kitsu for the attention, validation, and escape from daily life that Kitsu offers. Hence the line, Terribly terrible, she's a Villain. One as sweet as caramel, she's my Saint. Think I'm getting butterflies, but it's really, something telling me to run away!

And Kitsu is represented in the lines: No halo, baby I'm the reason why hell's so hot. Inferno, baby I'm the reason bad's so fun.

Kitsu knows she's not a good person. She's straight up told Missy that she won't change who she is, but she'll try to be better if only to make her feel better.

And the lines: Manic like a chandelier, crack the ceiling. Maria Antoinette, 'cause she's lost her head. Describes them both, because as cute as they are together. Their dynamic is not healthy.

"Where am I taking you?" The driver, a cape by the name of Overdrive, asks as I keep my long, prehensile tail wrapped around his neck.

"Just keep driving." I tell the paralyzed driver as I scan his DNA. His spine is actually completely in tact, it's his brain that's making him incapable of walking. Damaged motor pathways caused by alcohol abuse and a concussion or two.

Not that it matters, I'm just bored and killing time. Keeping myself distracted. His Corona Gemma isn't even compatible with mine. So I don't even have a reason to understand its makeup.

"Just let me know when you run out of gas." I yawn and lean back in the passenger seat. Resting my feet on the dash.

"I'll pass out before that happens." He says. "This thing uses heavy oil and a special gas converter to recycle the exhaust into more fuel."

"…" I look to him and shrug. "Meh. Then take me wherever."

"Hey, you don't need to do this." Miss Militia pipes up from the backseat. "You have a chance, like you said earlier. You don't have a record and-"

"Yeah, yeah. Sure thing Hannah." I say, and she goes quiet immediately. "Look, you can save the whole sales pitch. I know you just want me because you can't get rid of me. Same reason you tried for years to recruit the owner of my blueprints."

I don't even bother looking back to her. Content to stare out the window as the darkened city lights pass me by.

"That's not true." She says, putting her PR training to good use. "You're not Kitsu, her situation and yours are different. You don't-"

"Since when did hostages get so chatty?" I say and tighten my tail around Overdrive's neck, making him choke. "Keep talking, I don't mind if we crash."

Silence.

I loosen my hold on Overdrive's neck. Letting him breathe and focus on the road.

'Just as I thought.' I think to myself and look back out the window. Resting my chin on hand as I think. 'Everyone talks big, right up until they get a gun put to their head.'

Thunk! I'm brought from my thoughts by the heavy sound. A quick look to the sideview mirror tells be the cause when a brief flash of gold fur whips in view of the reflection.

"Ugh!" I groan and roll my eyes. "Is she still here?" I look to my driver. "Isn't there anything you can do about her? Some sort of, anti car jockey defense system. An emergency get off my roof button or some shit?"

"Language!" I hear Kitsu shout.

"Bite me!" I shout back.

"Not really-" He starts to say, but he forgets that I can sense everything in him when I touch him. And my tail is still securely around his neck.

"You're lying~" I say and lean over, pressing a sharp nail to his neck. Right over his carotid artery, feeling it thump under his skin. "Want to try that again?"

He gulps and reaches over. Flipping a switch that pops a small cap open. Revealing a blue button that he presses in before and turning. Making a soft whirring sound echo through the car's cabin.

"AIAIAIAIAIA!" I hear the fox scream in pain before her voice disappears behind us.

"Good boy." I pat his head and lean back in my seat. Relaxing as I enjoy the nighttime joyride.

"Electricity, why is it always electricity?" I whine to myself as I get up, muscles twitching in the aftershocks of pain.

It's not even that I can't absorb electricity. It just bypasses enough of my field that it over stimulates my nerves.

"CONDUIT!" I shout in frustration.

[Acknowledgement]

"Agh!" I clutch my head in pain. Feeling like I might crack my own skull from the pressure. Half of it isn't even making any sense. The other half barely making it through over the static that is the nonsense of the other half.

It feels like I just got given a book in chinese, and I have to decipher it. And to understand what it says, I have to start backwards.

'Make it make sense, damnit!' I demand.

[Response: Transferring second half]

The relief I felt when M- Carol and Mark showed up. The warmth I felt when she treated me and my blueprint the same.

I roll my eyes and turn away before I say something I shouldn't. reminding myself that it's not worth it. I force my attention back to the crowd, keeping an eye out for anything that might spark trouble. People are still pouring through the evacuation site in uneven waves. With all the confused, scared, and increasingly irate people, it's a miracle something hasn't caught fire yet.

"What's that sound?" I ask, getting Aegis's attention as we turn towards the barricade lining the street. Keeping any cars from barreling through.

"Sounds like some lunatic doesn't see the barricade." Aegis says and starts jogging towards the edge of the site.

Following him, I get a good look down the road as a muscle car in PRT colors kicks up dust from the asphalt road… somehow.

"Shit that's Overdrive's car." Aegis says and starts moving faster, calling out to the officers setting up a grappler turret to lock the car's front wheels. "Hey! Hey! He's one of ours!"

"Aegis…" I try to grab his attention as I get a bad feeling in my gut as the car doesn't slow. "Aegis!"

I stay put and get ready. Locking in on my tether to space, I get ready to twist and extend the road. Putting more distance and shifting the direction should I need to.

"Hey!" I hear Dennis shout as he jogs over in his mismatched armor. "What's going on- is that Overdrive's car?"

I flinch, not getting a chance to answer him as several people dive out of the way when the car refuses to slow. Even Aegis turns on his heels and sprints away. I pull on the distance between the car and road, extending it further. When suddenly,the car fishtails into drifting to a perfect stop just short of the barricades.

Nothing happens for a moment.

"… Well that was-" Dennis starts. "-Woah shit!"

The passenger door slams open and flies off the hinges with a bang. Soaring past us. Quickly looking back to check where the door sailed off, my head turns like a swivel to the car where someone, familiar steps out.

She looks exactly like Kitsu but wrong. Like a twisted wonderland version.

Less soft and more edges. Horns curling from her head. A long, whip-like tail swaying behind her.

Jean shorts. White tank top. Red jacket. Going barefoot as she steps out and stretches her arms above her horned head. Yawning like she just woke from a nap.

In terms of style and genre. If Kitsu is pop, this one is street rock. Less floof and more edge. In a literal sense in some ways.

"Thanks for the ride!" She says, turning back to the car. Lrearing back her leg, she soccer kicks the vehicle away. Making it tumble down the road. While the view from behind gives me a good view of her long, thin, black whiplike tail. And not a golden fluffy one.

'No way in hell is that Kitsu.' I think to myself. 'She'd sooner kill someone than mess with her tail like that.'

The doppleganger turns back around to face us, hand on her hip as she levels a smug, sharp toothed smirk at us

"Good morning, good people of the PRT!" The horned girl announces as she starts walking towards us. "I am here to justify your hazard pay and increase your life insurance premiums!"

'… why does she have to be cute?' I take a breath and clear the intrusive thoughts. 'Not the time! Dangerous life threatening cape now, weird teen hormones later.'

"Notice to all PRT, Protectorate and Capes." The strained voice of Miss Militia comes through over the comms. "That is not Kitsu at the med tents. I repeat, that is not Kitsu. It's a clone made by the monster before it was dispatched."

'I figured that.' I think to myself.

It takes all of five seconds for the attending able bodied PRT to raise their weapons against the newest threat.

"I warn you, do that and you'll-" She starts to say. But a few start to open fire immediately. Causing a chain reaction of panic, making more officers open fire in the confusion. Raining a mix of rubber bullets and live ammunition on the clone as all hell breaks loose.

She throws her arms out, growing and shifting them into large, red feathered wings. Intercepting the barrage before the feathers start hardening. Soon, they stop blocking the bullets and start repelling the bullets. The feathers turning into small plates of chitin that rattle and ring against the hail of impacts.

"Vista!" Dennis calls out and runs up to me. Now sporting a basic PRT Field helm, chest armor, and left shin guard to replace his damaged equipment. "I need you to get ready, as soon as there's a chance. Get me close."

"Are you insane?" I hiss at the ginger idiot. "If I warp space and a bullet strays into the path then it could hit someone on our side!"

"Well, what do you suggest?" He asks.

"I don't know!?" I put a hand to my chest. "Why are you asking me?"

"Well, treat it like Kitsu then." He hisses at me.

"Kitsu wouldn't even bother blocking." I point out. "She'd roll her eyes and shield her phone as she checked her snapchat."

As I say that, the scaled dome the clone had formed around herself recedes. Revealing the copycat now sporting scaly digitigrade legs ending in sharp talons. Sharp teeth bared in a wide, manic grin as her wings turn into long, clawed arms.

"I warned you~." She sings and dashes forward towards the nearest officer. Kicking him back and slamming him into a wall. Catching his gun mid fall in her hands as he drops it, and aiming it at the others. "Now say hello, to mai little friend!"

"She's got a gun!" Dennis runs back to the tents as she… wild fires into the buildings. Aiming for the windows and avoiding the people. Laughing maniacally as she causes panic with her property damage.

"How does her having a gun make her…" I stop myself from asking as I just run for cover myself. Not wanting to catch any possible strays.

I dive behind a PRT van and use my power to force the air on the other side of the van to warp. Twisting the space for about ten feet, forcing any bullets fired this way to arc upward as I duck down.

Click click, the sound of the empty gun echoes.

"Damn, was really hoping for more." I can barely pick up what she says as she starts walking towards us.

"So." I hear her more clearly as she stops at the front end of the cruiser I'm using for cover. "… Where's Amy?"

Fun fact. Corpses are inanimate, I can move inanimate objects. My power lets me know what I can and can't move.

The tension is palpable as we wait. Even Sophia seems to be trapped in a state of shock as she realizes she's not dead.

"You know, you almost had a point with the whole you need to act speech." Not Kitsu says. "But the thing is, you were half right, acting is meaningless if you don't have the means."

"What, the, f-fuck?" Sophia curses as the knife refuses to budge from the clone's chest. "Why can't I let go!?"

"Now that the side characters are-" She stops to catch a bolt aimed for her head. "… are out of the way." She snaps the bolt and drops it to the ground and points a finger at us, moving it between everyone here. "Let's see here… eeny, meeny, meiny, you!"

She disappears in a burst of speed. Running far faster than should be possible as her footsteps leave craters in the ground. Running right past me and to the tents, she only stops when she makes contact with someone.

"Oh, shit!" I turn on my heels as Aegis backpedals. Now sporting a fresh hand through his gut.

"I always wanted to see what makes you tick." She giggles, and Aegis hisses when something in him cracks. "Ooh! Re-pathing, that's neat… and you're scared. But I'd be surprised if you weren't."

"Can… can we not?" He asks.

"We can not, not do this." She says and rips out his spine. "You don't need this, do you?"

Giving the crowd a twirl to show off the outfit and playfully lean on one foot as she reaches out, stretching her arm twice the length like it was made of rubber; she snatches Miss Militia's mic and snaps her arm back to normal length.

"You can call me Anansi!" She announces with a smile and strikes a pose. "I may be little, but I can do big things!"

"That is not the name you were given." Miss Militia whispers out the side of her mouth.

"Tell that to Clockblocker." She looked up and gave the older hero a smug look. "Besides, Miss Shape was dumb."

Assault came up with the name.

.

.

-Meanwhile, Dallon House-

.

.

Kitsu POV

.

"…" I stare at the TV and watch as the camera zooms in on the girl's smiling face. And I watch her brown eyes briefly flash purple. "… That's it!" I stand up and start marching towards my room. "I'm coming out of retirement!"

No way in hell am I letting my knockoff get closer to Missy while she's available- I mean, emotionally vulnerable!

"Kitsu!" Mom shouts back. "You don't get to just come in and out of retirement at the drop of a hat!"

.

.

.

.

.

.

.

.

.

.

.

Bonus

.

.

Director Emily Piggot POV

.

"The brainwave scans all register the same as the baseline subject." Head Reseacher Jamez says, going through the papers. "If not for the auditory and olfactory cortex being significantly less complex, being more comparable to a baseline human. On top of the occipital lobe being twice as dense in neuron activity, which is borderline absurd given the original's already heightened visual capacity."

He rambles off, and though I don't understand entirely. I know enough to get the gist. Her brain is the same, barring the differences that one would expect from the changes in physiology.

"What is your conclusion?" I ask the shorter black man.

"Honestly?" He lets out a sigh and tosses the document on my desk. "If there's some mental compulsion in her that compels her to act certain ways, I can't find it. All parts of her brain that influence personality are damn near the same as the baseline subject. Amygdala is deformed in the same way, Hypothalamus is actual more normal than the baseline subject, Hippocampus is identical, if a bit smaller. Though, her prefrontal cortex is showing reduced activity."

"And that means?"

"Compared to the other centers?" He prompts. "Could be a natural result of her altered physiology, or it's the early signs the she's developing chronic depression disorder."

'Depression is a dangerous thing in an S class cape.' I think to myself. 'Best case scenario, she wallows in despair and just remains idle. But she's still technically human, and if I know anything about people it's that they rarely ever commit to idleness.'

We could be lucky and end up with a completely self neutralized entity. But I don't believe in luck, only preparation and opportunity.

Speaking of, there's another issue on my desk. On every director's desk.

[Class 5 top secret]

[Birdcage inmate report: 28 inmates accounted. 759 missing]

[On Friday, September 4th at approximately 9pm, the birdcage's spatial perimeter sensors detected an anomaly. In attempts to handle the disturbance, all external security measures activated at once to distort space and rearrange nearby topography in order to hinder the attempted breach. At approximately 9:05 pm, 300 inmate collars went dark, at 9:06 pm, Dragon went to investigate the anomaly. Initial evidence pointed towards mass violence. At 9:08 pm, Dragon confirmed that all but 28 inmates were missing from the Baumann Parahuman Containment Center. All collars offline, all unaccounted for inmates are believed to have escaped with the assistance of Ivan "Ebon" Evans using his umbra-kinesis based portals in tandem with abilities used by Glaistig Uaine. Bypassing 98% of the Contaiment Center's security surveillance measures.]

"Tell me, Jamez, do we have a way of permanently neutralizing the subject?" I ask the head researcher.

As expected, he already had an answer for me.

"Maybe if we had a few nuclear warheads laying around." He scoffed. "As it stands, she endlessly regenerates from any damage she receives. And the more severe the damage, the faster she regenerates. Stab her, it heals in a minute. Cut her arm off, it grows back in thirty seconds."

"What about her brain?" I ask.

"High focus pinpoint laser to the back of her head when she wasn't looking." He says. "Suffered no neurological damage or mental impairment. Didn't even show signs of confusion."

So she's just shy of invulnerable. And a stone's throw from being as immortal as Kitsu.

"Hmm…"

"You have a plan?" He asks.

"That's none of your concern." I tell him. "You're dismissed."

She's going to become active at some point. The difference is whether or not we're prepared for her to find something to do. Rather than risk utter chaos on waiting to see what she'll do, I believe it's possible to make use of her by being proactive and giving her something to do. It'll be a gamble, but with the clone wave, thousands dead or missing, the Empire's power vacuum and having just barely avoiding another Boston Games. Not even counting the Slaughterhouse Nine's end. We are stretched dangerously thin and running on fumes.

The city budget is already triple its overall yearly income in the collateral clean up costs alone. That's not even accounting for the loss of life, infrastructure, or industry. We cannot handle another event. Brockton will collapse if preparations are not made.

Looking down at the subject's, at Melody's, case file. I can't help but lament how desperate I'm getting. That I'd actually consider what I'm about to do.

"Preparation… and opportunity." I tell myself.

.

.

.

October 22, 2010 is a full moon.
